world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park features a mix of historic and modern amusement rides, including the wooden Roller Coaster, one of only seven scenic railways left in the world. The park also includes amusement arcades, catering facilities, and themed areas like the Pleasure Beach Gardens.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Great Yarmouth Pleasure Beach is a historic amusement park that has been a key attraction in the seaside resort town for over a century. It preserves rare rides like the scenic railway and has been a backdrop for cultural events, including music videos.
world knowledge.Details: The park operates seasonally from March to November and features 26 rides, including 4 roller coasters. It is owned by Pleasure & Leisure Corporation Ltd and continues to add new attractions, such as three new rides for 2024.

world knowledge.Name: Herstmonceux Castle
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Herstmonceux Castle is a 15th-century brick-built castle near Herstmonceux, East Sussex, England. It is one of the oldest significant brick buildings still standing in England. The castle was built using bricks from local clay by builders from Flanders. Construction began in 1441 under Sir Roger Fiennes and was completed by his son, Lord Dacre. The castle has been owned by Queen's University at Kingston since 1993. The estate includes Grade II* listed parks and gardens, a walled garden, and the Herstmonceux Science Centre.

Major_Events.Description: Construction began under Sir Roger Fiennes and was completed by his son, Lord Dacre.
The estate was temporarily confiscated after Sir Thomas Fiennes was convicted of murder and robbery.
The castle was dismantled, leaving only the exterior walls standing, and remained a ruin until the early 20th century.
The ruined building was transformed into a residence, with work completed by Sir Paul Latham in 1933.
The Royal Greenwich Observatory relocated to Herstmonceux Castle from Greenwich due to urban growth and light pollution.

Major_Events.Event: Purchase by Queen's University at Kingston
Major_Events.Description: The castle was purchased by Queen's University at Kingston and became the Bader International Study Centre (later renamed Bader College).

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Herstmonceux Castle is a medieval fortified house built primarily of brick, one of the first significant brick buildings in England. The restoration in the early 20th century incorporated architectural antiques from England and France, combining four internal courtyards into one large one.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The castle is one of the oldest significant brick buildings in England and has played various roles throughout history, including as a residence, observatory, and educational center. It is also a popular filming location and hosts medieval re-enactments and events.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Currently serves as an international study center (Bader College) for Queen's University at Kingston, hosting undergraduate and graduate programs, as well as summer specialty programs.
world knowledge.Details: The castle and grounds have been used for filming, including for BBC adaptations, Harry Potter-themed events, and the series My Lady Jane. The estate also hosts the Observatory Science Centre, which maintains the Grade II* listed telescopes and workshops. The castle is associated with historical re-enactment troops and hosts a large medieval weekend annually.

world knowledge.Name: Estadio Jalisco
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Estadio Jalisco is a football stadium located in Guadalajara, Mexico. It was opened in 1960 and has been a significant venue for football events, including hosting matches for two FIFA World Cups (1970 and 1986) and the 1999 FIFA Confederations Cup. It was the home ground of Guadalajara until 2010 and remains the home stadium of Atlas and Club Universidad de Guadalajara.

Major_Events.Description: Hosted eight matches, including six group matches, a quarterfinal, and the semifinal where Brazil defeated Uruguay 3-1.
Hosted six matches, including all three group matches involving Brazil, a round-of-16 match, a quarterfinal, and a semifinal.
Hosted eight games, including the third-place game.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The stadium features a grass surface, a seating capacity of 56,713, and has undergone several renovations, including the addition of a 360-degree screen above the field in 2017.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Estadio Jalisco is culturally significant as a major football venue in Mexico, hosting international tournaments and serving as a liaison between the people of Guadalajara and the Brazilian national team. It has been a central part of the local community and football history.
world knowledge.Details: The stadium was renovated in 2017 to replace seating, remodel dressing rooms, and add a 360-degree screen. It is centrally located in Colonia Independencia, in front of the Plaza de Toros Nuevo Progreso.

world knowledge.Name: Penobscot Narrows Bridge and Observatory
world knowledge.Physical_Area: 2,120 feet (646 m) long, 447 feet (136 m) tall
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Penobscot Narrows Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge that opened in December 2006, replacing the Waldo–Hancock Bridge built in 1931. It was designed as an emergency replacement and completed in just 42 months. The bridge features engineering innovations such as a cradle system for cable stays and carbon fiber strands, earning it recognition in Popular Science as one of the 100 best innovations of 2006.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of the Penobscot Narrows Observatory
Major_Events.Description: The observatory, the first bridge observation tower in the United States, opened to the public on May 19, 2007.
The bridge was closed on December 29, 2013, due to falling ice chunks damaging vehicles. It reopened the next day but closed again briefly in January 2014.
Solar-powered phones connecting to a suicide hotline were installed on the bridge in May 2015, following multiple suicides. The phones were later replaced after reports of malfunctions.
The bridge was briefly closed on December 7, 2017, when a woman armed with a shotgun was seen walking across it. She surrendered after negotiations with police.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The bridge is a cable-stayed design with a total length of 2,120 feet (646 m) and a height of 447 feet (136 m). It uses a cradle system for its cable stays, allowing individual strands to be inspected and replaced. The stays are protected by pressurized nitrogen gas to prevent corrosion. The west tower houses the observatory, which includes the fastest and tallest elevator in Maine.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Penobscot Narrows Bridge is notable for its innovative engineering and the Penobscot Narrows Observatory, the tallest public bridge observatory in the world. It has become a landmark for its views of the Penobscot River, Fort Knox State Historic Site, and Penobscot Bay.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Transportation (carries US 1/SR 3 over the Penobscot River) and tourism (observatory).
world knowledge.Details: The bridge has been the site of multiple suicides, leading to discussions about installing suicide barriers. Emergency phones were installed but faced operational issues. The total project cost was $85 million. The observatory is open seasonally from May 1 to October 31.

world knowledge.Name: Sveti Stefan
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Sveti Stefan, initially the capital of the Paštrovići community, became a protectorate of the Republic of Venice in 1423. It was fortified in the 15th century to defend against the Turks and became a haven for pirates. The island village was established in the 1800s with a population of about 400 people. In the 20th century, it was converted into a luxury hotel, and the remaining inhabitants were moved to the mainland. The resort was refurbished by Aman Resorts in 2009.

Major_Events.Description: The Yugoslav government converted the island village into a luxury hotel and moved the remaining inhabitants to the mainland.
The resort was refurbished by Aman Resorts and reopened as a 5-star hotel.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The island village was fortified in the 15th century. Villa Miločer, built between 1934 and 1936, is part of the resort and includes 8 suites, two of which are Queen Marija Suites.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Sveti Stefan is culturally significant as a historic fortified village and a former haven for pirates. It became an exclusive resort frequented by high-profile elites and celebrities.
world knowledge.Details: The Aman Sveti Stefan resort includes 58 guest rooms, cottages, and suites, with the main dining area located at The Piazza. The resort has been closed since early 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

world knowledge.Name: Reginald's Tower
world knowledge.Address: Eastern end of the city quay, Waterford, Ireland
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Reginald's Tower is a historic tower in Waterford, Ireland, and is the oldest civic building in Ireland. It was built by the Anglo-Normans after their conquest of Waterford, replacing an earlier Viking fortification. The tower has been used for various purposes including as a mint, a prison, and a military storehouse. It is an important remnant of Waterford's medieval urban defence system.

Major_Events.Event: Wedding of Richard de Clare and Aoife
Major_Events.Description: The wedding of Richard de Clare, the second Earl of Pembroke, and Aoife, daughter of Dermot MacMurrough, King of Leinster, took place in the tower.
King John visited the tower and ordered new coins to be struck there.
Richard II visited the tower and used it to store his munitions.
Coins were minted in Reginald's Tower by order of the Irish Parliament.
The tower’s cannons successfully deterred the forces of Perkin Warbeck, the pretender to the throne of Henry VII.
Oliver Cromwell's army successfully captured Waterford after a siege.
James II of England climbed to the top of the tower to take a last look at his lost kingdom before embarking for exile in France.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The tower is 54 feet high with a circular horizontal cross section and a diameter of 42½ feet. It is surmounted by a conical roof and has walls that are 10 feet wide at the base, tapering down to 7 feet at the top. It features a spiral staircase within the thick walls.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Reginald's Tower is culturally and historically significant as the oldest civic building in Ireland and an important remnant of Waterford's medieval urban defence system. It is the only urban monument in Ireland to retain a Norse or Viking name.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Currently houses the Waterford Viking Museum.
world knowledge.Details: The tower is located in the Waterford Viking Triangle and exhibits many archaeological finds from the 2003 dig at Woodstown on the River Suir near the city. A replica Viking longship is exhibited beside Reginald's Tower.

world knowledge.Name: Arena do Grêmio
world knowledge.Area: Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Arena do Grêmio was built to replace the Estádio Olímpico Monumental as the home stadium of Grêmio Foot-Ball Porto Alegrense. The idea emerged in the mid-2000s, with construction starting in 2010 and the stadium being inaugurated on December 8, 2012. The stadium was designed to be self-sustaining and meet FIFA standards.

Major_Events.Description: Arena do Grêmio was selected as one of the venues for the 2019 Copa América, where five matches were played in the stadium.
The first major event held at the stadium was a concert celebrating the 72nd birthday of singer Roberto Carlos, with a sold-out audience of 50,000.
The stadium hosted the first show of the 2014 Green Valley World Tour, featuring Dimitri Vegas & Like Mike, attended by over 14,000 fans.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The stadium was designed by PLARQ Arquitetura and built by OAS. It features a Desso GrassMaster surface, LED scoreboard, and 135 executive suites. The design follows a multi-use concept, allowing it to host various events beyond football matches.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Arena do Grêmio is one of the most modern stadiums in South America and received the highest rating in all aspects from Sisbrace, the Brazilian Ministry of Sport's football stadium evaluation system. It is also the only stadium in Brazil to receive a 'Category Four' evaluation from UEFA. The stadium is a symbol of Grêmio Foot-Ball Porto Alegrense's legacy and modern football infrastructure in Brazil.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Multi-use stadium, primarily for football matches
world knowledge.Details: The stadium complex includes a Conference and Congress Center, hotel, a mall, housing, condominiums, and parking. It is located a mile from the international airport of Porto Alegre and alongside the roadway, making it a multifunctional urban center. The stadium is functional year-round and adapts easily to host various genres of shows and events.

world knowledge.Name: Estadio BBVA
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Estadio BBVA, formerly known as Estadio BBVA Bancomer, replaced Estadio Tecnológico as the home of C.F. Monterrey after 63 years. It was inaugurated on 2 August 2015 with the Eusébio Cup match where Monterrey defeated Benfica 3–0. The stadium was developed by FEMSA, designed by Populous and VFO, and constructed by Aceros Lozano, GGP, and Maíz Mier.

Major_Events.Description: Inaugural match where Monterrey defeated Benfica 3–0.
Hosted 8 matches during the tournament.
Will host three group stage matches and one Round of 32 match.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Nicknamed 'El Gigante de Acero' (The Steel Giant), the stadium has a capacity of 53,500, a grass surface, suites, a club-themed restaurant, and a club lounge. The grandstand has a 34-degree inclination, and the distance between the field and seats is the minimum allowed by FIFA. It features sustainable design with green areas covering more than a third of the land, rainwater filtration systems, and integration with an Ecological Park.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Estadio BBVA is the fourth-largest stadium in Mexico and was the most expensive at the time of its construction. It is the first football stadium in North America to receive a silver LEED certification for sustainable design. The stadium offers scenic views of Cerro de la Silla and is a major venue for football events, including the upcoming 2026 FIFA World Cup.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Association football stadium, home of C.F. Monterrey, and venue for major football events.
world knowledge.Details: The stadium cost US$200 million to build. It includes high-end interior and exterior design, parking areas integrated with green spaces, and a view of Cerro de la Silla from the northwestern seats. The northern boundary connects to a wooded trail area leading to the New Ecological Park.

world knowledge.Name: Olympic Stadium (Montreal)
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Built as the main venue for the 1976 Summer Olympics, the stadium was designed by French architect Roger Taillibert. It faced numerous construction delays, cost overruns, and structural issues. Despite its problems, it has hosted major sports, concerts, and cultural events.

Major_Events.Description: Hosted the opening and closing ceremonies, athletics, football finals, and equestrian events.
Set a record attendance of 68,318 for the CFL championship game.
Montreal Expos lost to the Los Angeles Dodgers in a decisive playoff game.
Drew a stadium record 59,057 fans for baseball.
Attracted the largest paid crowd in stadium history (78,322).
A riot broke out after Guns N' Roses' performance, causing extensive damage.
Set a Canadian soccer attendance record (61,004).
Hosted several matches, including a semi-final between the USA and Germany.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed in Organic Modern style with a doughnut-shaped roof suspended from a 165-meter inclined tower (the tallest in the world). Features pre-stressed concrete construction and a retractable Kevlar roof (later replaced).
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: An iconic but controversial symbol of Montreal, representing both Olympic pride and financial mismanagement. It remains a key venue for major events despite its troubled history.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Multi-purpose stadium (sports, concerts, trade shows, and special events).

Cost.Total_Expenditure: C$1.61 billion (including repairs, interest, and inflation)

Details.Roof_Issues: Frequent tears, snow/rain restrictions, and multiple replacements. A new C$870 million roof is planned (2024).
Details.Transportation: Connected to Pie-IX and Viau metro stations.

world knowledge.Name: Monasterboice
world knowledge.Address: County Louth, Ireland, north of Drogheda
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Monasterboice (Irish: Mainistir Bhuithe) is the remains of an early Christian monastic settlement founded in the late 5th century by Saint Buithe. The site includes the remains of two churches built in the 14th century or later, an earlier round tower, and three high crosses from the 10th century. The monastic settlement fell into ruin after the establishment of the Cistercian Mellifont Abbey nearby in 1142. A parochial church was in use at the location by the 13th century.

Major_Events.Description: Founded by Saint Buithe (or Buite) in the late 5th century.
The monastic settlement fell into ruin after the establishment of the Cistercian Mellifont Abbey nearby.
The round tower was damaged in a fire.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The site includes the remains of two churches built in the 14th century or later, an earlier round tower about 28 metres tall, and three high crosses from the 10th century. The 5.5-metre Muiredach's High Cross is regarded as the finest high cross in Ireland, featuring biblical carvings of both the Old and New Testaments.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Monasterboice is a national monument of Ireland and is significant for its early Christian monastic history, high crosses, and round tower. The site is culturally important for its biblical carvings and historical association with Saint Buithe and the poet Flann Mainistrech.
world knowledge.Details: The property is owned by the National Monuments Service and is accessible to the public. Burials in the graveyard around the ruins continue in the present day. A copy of the main cross is held in the Victoria and Albert Museum in London.

world knowledge.Name: Xplor Park
world knowledge.Address: Kilometer Marker 282 Chetumal-Puerto Juárez Highway, Municipality of Solidaridad, Riviera Maya, Quintana Roo, Mexico
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Xplor Park is a privately owned adventure theme park opened in July 2009. It is part of the Xcaret Experiencias Group and was the second park opened by the company. The park is built into the landscape of the Yucatán Peninsula, featuring natural caves, rivers, and cenotes.

Major_Events.Description: The park opened to the public, featuring extensive zipline circuits and other adventure attractions.
Xplor welcomed its 2.5 millionth park visitor and proclaimed itself as the world's most-visited zip-line attraction.
A 5-in-1 four-person raft slide, marking the park's biggest expansion, opened alongside a new wave pool.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park is 80% natural, built into the existing jungle terrain with attractions utilizing caves and underground rivers. It features manmade structures like ziplines, amphibious vehicle tracks, and water-based attractions.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Xplor Park is renowned for its adventure attractions, particularly its extensive zipline circuits, which are among the most visited in the world. It highlights the natural beauty and unique geological features of the Yucatán Peninsula.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Adventure theme park offering ziplining, amphibious vehicle tracks, cave exploration, and water-based activities.

Main_Attractions: Underground Expedition (cave river wading and obstacle courses)

Awards.Award: Best Adventure Park in the World
Awards.Description: Awarded by the Association for Challenge Course Technology.

Special_Event.Name: Xplor Fuego
Special_Event.Description: Nighttime version of the park with the same attractions under different lighting and the night sky.

world knowledge.Name: Legoland Japan Resort
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Legoland Japan Resort is the first Legoland theme park in Japan and the second in Asia, opened on April 1, 2017. It was built by Merlin Entertainments with a budget of USD $250 million. The park was designed to attract over two million visitors annually and features over 40 attractions using approximately 17 million Lego bricks.

Major_Events.Description: Merlin Entertainments announced plans to open a Legoland Resort in Nagoya on June 30, 2014.
Construction officially began on April 15, 2015.
Legoland Japan Resort opened to the public on April 1, 2017.

Major_Events.Event: Legoland Hotel and Sea Life Aquarium Announcement
Major_Events.Description: Merlin Entertainments announced plans to build a Legoland Hotel and a Sea Life aquarium next to the park in 2018.
The park was closed on February 28, 2020, due to the COVID-19 pandemic and reopened on March 23, 2020, with limited services and safety measures.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park features seven themed areas, including Bricktopia, Miniland, Adventure, Lego City, Knight's Kingdom, Pirate Shores, and The Factory. It includes miniature townscapes of Japanese landmarks built from Lego bricks, interactive attractions, and rides. The park uses over 17 million Lego bricks and includes a Legoland Hotel and Sea Life aquarium.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Legoland Japan Resort is culturally significant as it combines the global appeal of Lego toys with Japanese culture and landmarks. It serves as a family-friendly entertainment destination and promotes creativity and interactive learning through its attractions and workshops.
world knowledge.Details: The park includes over 40 attractions, a Legoland Hotel, and a Sea Life aquarium. It features themed areas such as Miniland with Lego recreations of Japanese landmarks, interactive workshops, and rides. The park is accessible via the Nagoya Rinkai Rapid Transit Aonami Line and offers various dining and shopping options.

world knowledge.Name: Waldschlösschen Bridge
world knowledge.Physical_Area: 635 metres (2,083 ft) length, 14m carriageway & 2 cantilevered paths each 4.45m width
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Waldschlösschen Bridge was built to alleviate inner-city traffic congestion in Dresden. Its construction was highly controversial due to its location in the Dresden Elbe Valley, a UNESCO World Heritage Site at the time. UNESCO threatened to revoke the site's World Heritage status if the bridge were built, which ultimately happened in 2009.

Major_Events.Description: A public referendum resulted in a majority voting for the construction of the bridge.
The Dresden Elbe Valley was delisted as a UNESCO World Heritage Site due to the construction of the bridge, becoming only the second site ever to be delisted.
The bridge was officially opened on 24 August 2013 and opened to vehicular traffic two days later.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Steel arch bridge made of steel and concrete, with a total length of 635 metres and a longest span of 148 metres. Designed by Kolb Ripke (architects) and engineered by EiSat.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The bridge's construction led to the delisting of the Dresden Elbe Valley as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, marking a significant cultural and environmental controversy. It is a notable example of the tension between urban development and heritage preservation.
world knowledge.Details: The bridge was designed to remedy inner-city traffic congestion. Its construction was delayed due to legal battles and environmental concerns, particularly the protection of the endangered lesser horseshoe bat. The project cost approximately €180 million.

world knowledge.Name: Centreville Amusement Park
world knowledge.Address: Middle Island, Toronto Islands, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Centreville Amusement Park was built as part of a master plan to convert the Toronto Islands' land usage from cottage residences to recreational uses. It replaced the old Sunnyside Amusement Park (closed in 1955) and Hanlan's Point Amusement Park (closed in the 1930s). The park opened in 1967 and has expanded over the years, adding rides annually. It features a 1900s turn-of-the-century village theme and includes an 1870s cast iron planter originally from St. Lawrence Market.

Major_Events.Description: Due to flooding, Centreville did not open in May 2017. The park reopened on July 31, 2017, but some rides remained closed due to flood damage. The Far Enough Farm remained closed until 2018. The financial loss was estimated at CA$8 million, with repair costs at CA$6 million.
Centreville and Far Enough Farm were closed for the entire 2020 season due to the COVID-19 pandemic. They reopened in 2021 with reduced capacity, online ticket sales, and COVID-19 screening measures.

The park's 1907-vintage carousel was conditionally sold to Carmel, Indiana, due to financial losses from the 2017 flooding. The sale was later canceled, and the carousel remained in Toronto after negotiations with the city.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park features a 1900s turn-of-the-century village theme. It includes a 1907-vintage carousel by the Dentzel Carousel Company, an antique ferris wheel (originally from Crystal Beach Amusement Park), and various themed rides and attractions.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Centreville Amusement Park is a beloved family destination and a key recreational site on the Toronto Islands. It preserves historic amusement park elements, such as the Dentzel carousel and antique ferris wheel, and provides a nostalgic experience with its turn-of-the-century theme.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Amusement park and recreational facility for children and families.
world knowledge.Details: The park includes rides like a carousel, log flume, ferris wheel, haunted barrel works, miniature roller coaster, and bumper boats. It also features Far Enough Farm, a hobby farm with domesticated animals. The park operates seasonally from May through September and is managed by William Beasley Enterprises Ltd. under a lease from the City of Toronto.

world knowledge.Name: Upper Clements Parks
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Upper Clements Parks was a seasonal theme park opened in 1989 by the province of Nova Scotia. It was later operated by various groups, including Amsdale Resources Management and the Hanse Society (Upper Clements Parks Society). The park faced challenges such as declining attendance and neglect but saw improvements under new management. It eventually closed in 2019 due to falling visitor numbers and needed repairs.

Major_Events.Description: The park was built by the province and opened at a cost of $23 million.
A group of 16 businessmen from Hong Kong, under the name Amsdale Resources Management, were awarded a three-year lease to run the park. They made numerous cuts, and annual attendance dropped.

The Hanse Society (a group of Annapolis Valley businesses) was awarded a 10-year lease to operate the park, which was in a state of neglect. They received government funding and improved the park's condition.

Major_Events.Event: Park Purchase by Upper Clements Parks Society
Major_Events.Description: The non-profit Hanse Society (Upper Clements Parks Society) purchased the theme park for $1 million, with the province funding capital improvements.
The park closed after the 2019 season due to falling visitor numbers and significant repair needs.
The land was purchased by Annapolis County municipal council for $600,000, with plans to build a boarding school under the Gordonstoun name.

Major_Events.Event: Sale Overturned by Nova Scotia Supreme Court
Major_Events.Description: The sale and lease of the land were overturned by the Nova Scotia Supreme Court following an application by the newly elected council.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park featured over 40 rides and attractions, including a wooden coaster, a water coaster, and a wading pool. In 2012, an Adventure Park was added with ziplines and bridges.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Upper Clements Parks was a significant local attraction, generating jobs and driving the local economy. It was also a recreational hub for visitors, including cadets from the nearby CFB Cornwallis and CSTC HMCS Acadia.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Seasonal theme park and adventure park offering rides, attractions, and family entertainment.

Details.Mascot: Clementine, joined by Clarence the train engineer and Captain Kid Ryerson the pirate.
Details.Water_Rides: Waterslide Flume Ride, Wading Pool, Bumper Boats

world knowledge.Name: Brean Leisure Park
world knowledge.Address: Holiday Resort Unity, Brean, Somerset, England
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally a dairy farm known as Unity Farm, the land was gradually converted into a leisure park starting in 1948. Over the decades, it evolved with the addition of caravans, camping, recreational activities, and eventually amusement park features. The park has grown into a major leisure destination, attracting visitors from South Wales, Bristol, and Birmingham.

Major_Events.Description: An independent greyhound racing track was opened on 3 July 1975.
The greyhound track closed on 12 March 1984.
A one million GBP investment resulted in the opening of the American-themed RJ's Entertainment complex.
On 18 July 2014, the park was sold to a family from Barry Island in South Wales.
A £2 million GBP investment was made to expand Brean Splash with a new indoor splash area.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park features a mix of recreational and leisure facilities, including amusement rides, a waterpark, golf course, and entertainment venues. The design is focused on family-friendly attractions and holiday accommodations.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Brean Leisure Park is a significant leisure destination in Somerset, offering entertainment and holiday facilities. It has hosted concerts, TV show filming, and various recreational activities, making it a cultural hub for visitors.
world knowledge.Details: The park is open from March to November annually and has been a venue for concerts, TV shows like 'Brainiac: Science Abuse', 'Casualty', 'The Sparticle Mystery', and 'Rosie and Jim'. It also features Brean Splash waterpark and a golf course. The park attracts over 750,000 visitors per year.

world knowledge.Name: Hartland Covered Bridge
world knowledge.Address: Hartland Bridge Hill Road, Hartland - Somerville, New Brunswick, Canada
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Hartland Covered Bridge, originally opened in 1901, is the world's longest covered bridge. It was initially uncovered and a toll bridge but was rebuilt and covered in 1921 after structural damage from weather. It was designated a National Historic Site of Canada in 1977 and a Provincial Heritage Place in 1999. The bridge has served as a vital crossing over the Saint John River, connecting the communities of Hartland and Somerville.

Major_Events.Description: The bridge was opened on May 14, 1901, after construction began in 1899. It was initially uncovered and operated as a toll bridge.
Heavy rainfall and ice caused two spans to collapse on April 6, 1920. The bridge was reconstructed and covered with a roof by 1921.
The bridge was designated a National Historic Site of Canada on November 17, 1977.
In December 2023, the bridge's load limit was reduced from ten tonnes to three tonnes following structural repairs.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The bridge is a Howe truss covered bridge made of concrete piers and wood truss. It spans 1,282 feet (391 m) with seven spans, five of which are 51 metres (167 ft) and two are 43.9 metres (144 ft). It features a single lane and a covered walkway for pedestrians.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Hartland Covered Bridge is culturally and historically significant as the world's longest covered bridge. It represents early 20th-century engineering and has been a vital transportation link in New Brunswick. Its designation as a National Historic Site and Provincial Heritage Place underscores its importance to Canadian heritage.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Originally a transportation bridge, it now serves primarily as a tourist attraction with restricted vehicle access.
world knowledge.Details: The bridge was part of the Trans-Canada Highway and connects New Brunswick Route 103 to New Brunswick Route 105. It has suffered damage from weather, vandalism, and vehicle accidents over the years. In 2006, a piece of the bridge was used in the Six String Nation project's Voyageur guitar. A Google Doodle celebrated its 111th anniversary in 2012.

world knowledge.Name: Gardaland
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Gardaland Resort is an amusement park resort located in northern Italy, opened on 19 July 1975. The concept for Gardaland dates to the early 1970s when Livio Furini, an entrepreneur from Verona, was inspired by a visit to Disneyland in California. Since October 2006, the park has been owned by the British company Merlin Entertainments.

Major_Events.Description: Gardaland opened on 19 July 1975, built on the eastern shore of Lake Garda at Castelnuovo del Garda.
Merlin Entertainments took ownership of the park in 2006.
Gardaland Hotel opened, which was the first hotel in Italy to provide themed accommodation.
A Sea Life aquarium opened on site.
Gardaland Adventure Hotel opened, featuring 100 themed rooms.
Gardaland Magic Hotel opened, comprising 128 rooms with three themes.
The first Legoland Waterpark in Europe was launched in the park.
Gardaland reopened on 13 June 2020, making it the first Italian amusement park to reopen after the COVID-19 lockdown.
The park opened a ride called Jumanji - The Adventure, featuring a large animatronic figure.
Another Jumanji-themed attraction named Jumanji - The Labyrinth opened in the park.
The park plans to celebrate its 50th anniversary with a remodelled area named Dragon Empire.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Gardaland Resort includes Gardaland Park, Gardaland Sea-Life, Legoland Waterpark, Gardaland Hotel, Adventure Hotel, and Magic Hotel. The hotels feature themed accommodations with various designs such as Arctic, Arabian, jungle, Wild West, Enchanted Forest, Magic Ice Castle, and Great Wizard.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Gardaland is ranked as the eighth most visited theme park in Europe, with just under three million annual visitors. It has been a significant part of Italian popular culture, especially with its mascot Prezzemolo, a young dragon popular in the Italian licensing market during the 1990s and 2000s.
world knowledge.Details: Gardaland's mascot is a young dragon named Prezzemolo, the protagonist of an Italian animated television series. The park has several major attractions including Mammut, Jungle Rapids, Fuga Da Atlantide, Shaman, Blue Tornado, Raptor, and Oblivion: The Black Hole. In 2024, Gardaland was listed as the eighth most popular theme park in Europe, having received 2,950,000 visitors in a year.

world knowledge.Name: Bowen Bridge
world knowledge.Physical_Area: Total length: 976 metres (3,202 ft), Width: 21.4 metres (70 ft)
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Bowen Bridge is named after British colonist John Bowen, who founded the first European settlement in Tasmania. It was constructed to mitigate future bridge failures following the Tasman Bridge disaster. The bridge was designed to withstand significant impacts from river barges and features massive reinforced concrete caisson structures.

Major_Events.Description: Prime Minister Malcolm Fraser revealed the bridge's name at a public ceremony at Dowsings Point on 10 October 1980.
The bridge was officially opened on 23 February 1984 by Prime Minister Bob Hawke.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Bowen Bridge is a segmental cantilever road bridge composed of eight river spans, each measuring 109 metres (358 ft). It features two individual box girders erected side by side and connected by an in situ longitudinal joint. The bridge was constructed using a balanced cantilever technique without falsework within the river, a pioneering approach in Australia at that time.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The bridge serves as a vital transportation link in Hobart, connecting Clarence and Glenorchy. It is named after John Bowen, a key figure in Tasmania's colonial history, and was built to ensure resilience following the Tasman Bridge disaster.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Facilitating the movement of vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists across the River Derwent.
world knowledge.Details: The bridge cost A$49 million to construct. It links the East Derwent Highway with the Brooker Highway and is maintained by the Department of Infrastructure, Energy and Resources. The bridge's design allows for future reinforcement to withstand greater impacts.

world knowledge.Name: Cavallino Matto
world knowledge.Address: Marina di Castagneto Carducci, Tuscany, Italy
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Cavallino Matto is the largest amusement park in Tuscany. The park began as a free playground in 1967 called 'Parco Gulliver' (Gulliver Park). It was expanded in the 1990s with amusement park rides and renamed. Additional rides were added in 2001. In February 2006, the Manfredi family bought the park and renovated it with new attractions, including live shows.

Major_Events.Description: The park was expanded with amusement park rides and renamed from 'Parco Gulliver' to 'Cavallino Matto'.
Additional rides were added to the park.
The Manfredi family bought the park and renovated it with new attractions, including live shows.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park is located in a pine forest and includes various amusement rides, dining facilities, and live performance areas. It features five roller coasters, water rides, and animatronic animal displays.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Cavallino Matto is culturally significant as the largest amusement park in Tuscany, offering entertainment and recreational activities for families and tourists.
world knowledge.Details: The park operates five roller coasters ('Freestyle', 'Project 1', 'Speedy Gonzales', 'Topozorro', and 'Wild Mine'), water rides like 'Baia dei Bucanieri', and attractions such as 'Safari Adventure' with animatronic animals. Shows include a 3D cinema ('Movie Stars Theatre') and live performances by acrobats and orchestras.

world knowledge.Name: Barry's Amusements
world knowledge.Address: 16 Eglinton Street, Portrush, County Antrim, Northern Ireland
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Barry's Amusements was founded in 1925 by Francesco Trufelli, a former trapeze artist and manager of the Royal Italian Circus, and Evelyn Chipperfield of the Chipperfield's Circus family. It became the longest-running amusement park in Northern Ireland. The park was named after the first supplier to arrive on-site, Barr. The Trufelli family operated the park for four generations until it was sold in 2021. It reopened in 2022 as Curry's Fun Park under a long-term lease by the Curry family.

Major_Events.Description: Barry's Amusements was founded by Francesco Trufelli and Evelyn Chipperfield.
The park was offered for sale as a going concern but was unable to open in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
The park reopened under a long-term lease by the Curry family and was renamed Curry's Fun Park Portrush.
Barry's Amusements, specifically The Big Dipper and Ghost Train, was featured in season 3, episode 3 of the television series Derry Girls.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park features a mixture of traditional and modern amusements, including roller coasters and water rides. The Speedy Mouse roller coaster, refurbished in 2010, had carts designed to look like Speedy Gonzales.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Barry's Amusements was the largest and longest-running amusement park in Northern Ireland, playing a significant role in local entertainment and employing many teenagers and university students from the area. It also gained cultural recognition through its feature in the television series Derry Girls.
world knowledge.Details: The park was normally open from Easter Monday until the first week in September. It was sold to property developer Michael Herbert in 2021 and later leased to the Curry family. The park's slogan is 'Let the fun begin.' The website is www.barrysamusements.com.

world knowledge.Name: Beijing Shijingshan Amusement Park
world knowledge.Address: No.25, Shijingshan Road, Shijingshan District, Beijing, China
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Beijing Shijingshan Amusement Park opened on 28 September 1986 as one of Beijing's first amusement parks. The park initially featured the Atomic Roller Coaster and other rides. Over the years, it expanded with new roller coasters and attractions, including a rebuilt Crazy Mouse roller coaster. The original Atomic Coaster closed in 2018 after 24 years of operation. In 2021, the park underwent an upgrade adding three new roller coasters.

Major_Events.Description: The park opened with the Atomic Roller Coaster and other rides.
The park was exposed by international media for using Japanese and American cartoon characters without authorization, including resemblances to Disney's trademark characters.
The park was expanded and refurbished, and Disney-themed characters may have been removed.
The park added three new roller coasters as part of an upgrade.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The park features structures resembling Disney's Sleeping Beauty Castle and Epcot's Spaceship Earth, along with various themed rides and attractions.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: As one of Beijing's first amusement parks, it holds historical significance in the development of recreational spaces in China. The park's controversies over unauthorized use of international cartoon characters also highlight issues of intellectual property in China.

Details.Public_transport: Served by Bajiao Amusement Park station on Line 1 of the Beijing Subway and Bus 663.

world knowledge.Name: Roman Bridge (Trier)
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Roman Bridge (Römerbrücke) is the oldest standing bridge in Germany and the oldest Roman bridge north of the Alps. Its nine bridge pillars date from the 2nd century AD, replacing two older wooden bridges that date back to at least 17 BC. In Roman times, tossing a coin off the bridge into the Moselle was considered an offering of good luck. The upper part was renewed in the early 12th and early 18th centuries after suffering destruction in war.

Major_Events.Description: Replaced two older wooden bridges dating back to at least 17 BC.
Renewed after suffering destruction in war.
Renewed again after suffering destruction in war.
Inscribed as part of 'Roman Monuments, Cathedral of St Peter and Church of Our Lady in Trier' due to its historical importance and architecture.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Made of stone, the bridge features nine bridge pillars dating from the 2nd century AD.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The bridge is historically significant as the oldest standing bridge in Germany and the oldest Roman bridge north of the Alps. It was part of Roman traditions, where tossing a coin into the Moselle from the bridge was considered an offering of good luck. Its architectural and historical importance led to its UNESCO World Heritage inscription in 1986.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Bridge for crossing the Moselle River.
world knowledge.Details: The bridge is also known as the Moselle Bridge. It is part of the UNESCO World Heritage site 'Roman Monuments, Cathedral of St Peter and Church of Our Lady in Trier' under reference 367-002. The inscription criteria were cultural: (i), (iii), (iv), (vi).

world knowledge.Name: Bridge of Sighs
world knowledge.Address: Connects the New Prison (Prigioni Nuove) to the interrogation rooms in the Doge's Palace, Venice, Italy
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Bridge of Sighs is an enclosed bridge made of white limestone, designed by Antonio Contin and built in 1600. It connects the New Prison to the interrogation rooms in the Doge's Palace. The name was given by Lord Byron in the 19th century, inspired by the sighs of prisoners who would see their last view of Venice through the bridge's windows before imprisonment.

Major_Events.Description: The bridge was built to connect the New Prison to the Doge's Palace interrogation rooms.
Lord Byron named the bridge 'Bridge of Sighs' as a translation from the Italian 'Ponte dei sospiri', inspired by the prisoners' sighs.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The bridge is an enclosed arch bridge made of Istrian stone, with windows featuring stone bars. It spans the Rio di Palazzo and is 11 metres (36 ft) long.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Bridge of Sighs is culturally significant for its historical role in Venice's judicial system and its romanticized portrayal in literature, music, and film. It has inspired numerous works of art, including operas, songs, and films, and is associated with a romantic legend about eternal love if a couple kisses beneath it at sunset.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Originally served as a passage for prisoners between the New Prison and the Doge's Palace interrogation rooms.
world knowledge.Details: The bridge has inspired similar structures worldwide, including the Allegheny County Jail complex in Pittsburgh. It has been featured in various cultural works, such as the 1979 film 'A Little Romance', the opera 'Le pont des soupirs' by Jacques Offenbach, and songs by artists like Robin Trower, the Small Faces, Marillion, and Giles Corey.

world knowledge.Name: Schierstein Bridge
world knowledge.Address: Between Mainz-Mombach, Rhineland-Palatinate and Wiesbaden-Schierstein, Hesse, Germany
world knowledge.Physical_Area: 1,282 m (4,206 ft) long, 26 m (85 ft) wide
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Schierstein Bridge was constructed as part of a road development program to improve connectivity in the Rhine-Main Region. It was designed to link Bundesautobahn 66 on the right bank of the Rhine with Bundesstraße 9 (now Landstraße 419) on the left bank. The bridge was necessary to create a traffic ring around Mainz and Wiesbaden to handle increasing traffic from Frankfurt and Darmstadt.

Major_Events.Description: The bridge was closed from mid-February to mid-April 2015 due to extensive structural damage, including a tilted supporting pillar.
Extensive repairs were carried out to address corrosion and other structural issues, including replacing deck sealing, pavement, and bearings, at a cost of 21 million euros.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The bridge consists of six individual structures made of prestressed concrete, composite, and steel. It features a uniform design despite crossing multiple sections of the Rhine and its floodplains. The bridge includes two traffic lanes, emergency lanes, and combined bike-and-walkways on each side. The river piers have rounded rectangular cross-sections and were founded on caissons.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Schierstein Bridge is a key infrastructure project in the Rhine-Main Region, facilitating transportation and economic development. It also marks the border between Rhineland-Palatinate and Hesse, with a landmark monument displaying the coats of arms of both states.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Highway bridge carrying Bundesautobahn 643 over the Rhine River.
world knowledge.Details: The bridge was designed to handle 23,000 vehicles per day but now regularly sees 80,000 vehicles, leading to wear and tear. Speed limits have been reduced over time to mitigate damage. A replacement bridge is being planned due to the structure's deteriorating condition. The bridge is maintained by the Hessian administration, as most of it lies in Hesse.

world knowledge.Name: Thorpe Park
world knowledge.Address: Thorpe Park, Staines Road, Chertsey, Surrey, KT16 8PN, England
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Thorpe Park was built on the site of a former gravel pit, which was partially flooded in the early 1970s to create a water-based leisure attraction. The park officially opened on 24 May 1979 and has since grown into a major theme park in the UK. It was initially themed around the 'History of the British People as a Maritime Nation' and featured attractions like a replica Stone Age cave, Celtic farm, Norman castle, and Viking camp. Over the years, it transitioned into a modern theme park with roller coasters and themed rides.

Major_Events.Description: Thorpe Park was formally opened to the public by Lord Louis Mountbatten on 24 May 1979, featuring lakes, parkland, and historical exhibits.
The Water Ski World Championships were held on the lake at the site before the park's official opening.
The Swarm, a Bolliger & Mabillard wing coaster, was opened, marking a significant addition to the park's thrill rides.
Hyperia, the UK's tallest and fastest rollercoaster, opened to the public on 24 May 2024, after years of planning and construction.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Thorpe Park features a mix of themed zones, each with unique architectural styles. For example, 'Amity' is designed as a 1950s-era American fishing village, while 'The Lost City' resembles the ruins of an Atlantean civilization. The park includes modern roller coasters, water rides, and dark rides, with structures like a crashed plane and a partially destroyed church in 'Swarm Island' adding to the immersive experience.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Thorpe Park is culturally significant as one of the UK's premier theme parks, attracting millions of visitors annually. It is known for its record-breaking roller coasters and themed attractions, contributing to the UK's leisure and entertainment industry. The park also hosts annual events like Fright Nights, which is the largest Halloween event in the UK.
world knowledge.Details: Thorpe Park is operated by Merlin Entertainments and features 27 attractions, including 8 roller coasters and 4 water rides. The park is divided into themed zones such as Amity, Lost City, and Swarm Island. It has a maximum capacity of 15,000 guests and includes on-site accommodation at the Thorpe Shark Cabins. The park's slogan is 'The Home Of Feel-Good Thrills,' and it targets teenagers and young adults with its high-thrill rides, though it also caters to families with attractions like Big Easy Boulevard.

world knowledge.Name: Iwakurojima Bridge
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Great Seto Bridge was envisioned as early as 1889 by Jinnojo Ōkubo, a member of the Prefectural Parliament, who advocated for better transportation links in Shikoku. The idea gained urgency after a 1955 ferry disaster that killed 171 people, including 100 students. Construction began in 1978 after delays due to the 1973 oil shock and was completed in 1988. The bridge was opened by then-Crown Prince Akihito.

Major_Events.Description: A collision of two ferries in dense fog off Takamatsu killed 171 people, including 100 students, prompting calls for a safer crossing.
Construction of the Great Seto Bridge began after the publication of the Environment Assessment Report, following delays due to the 1973 oil shock.
The bridge was officially opened to road and rail traffic by then-Crown Prince Akihito on April 10, 1988.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Great Seto Bridge is a double-decked bridge system with an upper deck carrying four lanes of highway traffic (Seto-Chūō Expressway) and a lower deck with two railway tracks (Seto-Ōhashi Line). The longest span, the Minami Bisan-Seto Bridge, is 1,100 meters (3,600 feet). The bridge used 3.646 million cubic meters of concrete and 705,000 tons of steel in its construction.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The bridge is a key part of the Honshū–Shikoku Bridge Project, connecting Honshū and Shikoku islands and significantly improving transportation and communication between the regions. It fulfills a century-old vision of linking Shikoku to the mainland and stands as a symbol of engineering achievement and safety improvements following the 1955 ferry disaster.
world knowledge.Details: The bridge consists of six named bridges and five viaducts, with a total length of 13.1 kilometers (8.1 miles). It is the only route in the Honshū–Shikoku Bridge Project to carry rail traffic. The lower deck was designed to accommodate future Shinkansen tracks for the proposed Shikoku Shinkansen line. The bridge reduced the crossing time from about an hour by ferry to 20 minutes by car or train.

world knowledge.Name: The D Las Vegas
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as the Sundance Hotel in 1980, it was later renamed Fitzgeralds in 1987 after being sold to Lincoln Management Group. The property underwent multiple ownership changes, including being acquired by Don Barden in 2001, making him the first African American casino owner in Las Vegas. In 2011, it was sold to Derek and Greg Stevens, who rebranded it as The D Las Vegas in 2012 after a $22 million renovation.

Major_Events.Description: The hotel opened on July 2, 1980, on land owned by Moe Dalitz, an organized crime figure.
The property was sold to Lincoln Management Group and renamed Fitzgeralds Las Vegas.
Don Barden purchased the property, becoming the first African American casino owner in Las Vegas.

Major_Events.Event: Rebranding as The D Las Vegas
Major_Events.Description: Derek and Greg Stevens completed a $22 million renovation and rebranded the property as The D Las Vegas.
The D became the first casino in the world to accept Bitcoin for hotel rooms, restaurants, and gift shop items.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The D Las Vegas is a 34-story hotel with a modern design following its 2012 renovation. It features a two-floor casino with a 'Vintage Vegas' theme on the second floor, including the only operational Sigma Derby game in Las Vegas. The property also includes LED signage, interactive video exhibitions, and themed bars.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The D Las Vegas is significant for its role in the revitalization of downtown Las Vegas and its historical transitions through various ownerships, including its notable rebranding under Derek and Greg Stevens. It also holds cultural importance as the first casino to accept Bitcoin.
world knowledge.Details: The D Las Vegas features several restaurants, including Joe Vicari's Andiamo Italian Steakhouse and American Coney Island. It has three distinct bars: Longbar, D Bar, and Vue Bar. The property also includes a 2,000 square foot sports bar and sportsbook called BarCanada, themed after Canadian culture and hockey. The casino has over 1,000 slot machines and 22 table games.

world knowledge.Name: Catalina Casino
world knowledge.Address: Avalon, Santa Catalina Island, California, United States
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Catalina Casino is an entertainment facility in Avalon on Santa Catalina Island, off the coast of Los Angeles in California, US. It is the largest building on the island and the most visible landmark in Avalon Bay when approaching the island from the mainland. The large building contains a movie theater, ballroom, and formerly an island art and history museum. The Catalina Casino gets its name from the Spanish term casino, meaning a 'gathering place' or establishment used for social interactions and sometimes shows and dances. Contrary to the common English usage of the word casino, this has never been a facility for gambling.

Major_Events.Description: The new Catalina Casino was completed under the direction of William Wrigley Jr. and David M. Renton, at a cost of $2 million.
The theater underwent a $750,000 restoration that reupholstered all of its seats and cleaned its murals.

Major_Events.Event: First live full production of a musical
Major_Events.Description: The Santa Catalina Island Company presented Grease! on the Casino's stage.
The Catalina Island Museum relocated to a new building, located approximately one half mile from its original location in the Catalina Casino.
The Catalina Island Company stopped screening first-run showings of movies, citing the rise of streaming services and satellite television as contributing factors to low attendance.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Art Deco and Mediterranean Revival styles, round, cantilevered reinforced concrete column structure. The building interiors were decorated in the Art Deco style, including with sterling silver and gold-leaf accents. The Avalon Theatre is sound insulated, with a circular domed ceiling noted for its acoustics. The theater's interior walls retain the original Art Deco murals by John Gabriel Beckman. The upper-level houses the world's largest circular ballroom, with a 180-foot diameter dance floor. The building has two ramped walkways in enclosed towers that extend out from the circular building.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Catalina Casino is culturally significant as a historic entertainment facility and gathering place on Santa Catalina Island. It was the first movie theater designed specifically for films with sound and has hosted numerous notable events and visitors. The building also served as the island's civil defense shelter and housed the Catalina Island Museum, which preserves the history of the island.
world knowledge.Details: The Catalina Casino was built on a site formerly known as Sugarloaf Point. The steel structure of the predecessor Sugarloaf Casino can still be found in Avalon's abandoned bird park. The theater remains available for daily tours and special events such as the Catalina Film Festival and Silent Film Benefit. The Catalina Island Museum continues documenting Catalina Island history and is the repository for all archeological digs on the island, with one of the largest collections of Tongva artifacts in the world.

world knowledge.Name: The Mirage
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Mirage was a defunct casino resort on the Las Vegas Strip, opened on November 22, 1989, by developer Steve Wynn. It was the first megaresort on the Strip, costing $630 million to build. The resort featured non-traditional attractions like an artificial volcano, dolphin habitats, and a tropical forest display. It played a pivotal role in revitalizing Las Vegas tourism and inspired a building boom of large resorts in the 1990s. The property closed on July 17, 2024, and is set to reopen as Hard Rock Las Vegas by May 2027.

Major_Events.Description: The Mirage opened as the world's most expensive resort, featuring innovative attractions like an artificial volcano and animal habitats.
The famous magic show by Siegfried & Roy became a top attraction, running for nearly 14 years until Roy Horn was injured by a tiger during a performance.
Cirque du Soleil debuted its first Las Vegas show, Nouvelle Expérience, at The Mirage.

Major_Events.Event: Rebranding to Hard Rock Las Vegas
Major_Events.Description: The Mirage closed for a complete renovation and rebranding by Hard Rock International, including the demolition of the iconic volcano.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Mirage featured a South Seas/Polynesian theme with a 29-story Y-shaped hotel tower. The exterior included gold-tinted windows and a nine-story domed atrium housing a tropical rainforest. The resort's design emphasized convenience and grandeur, with attractions like an artificial volcano and a lush indoor jungle.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Mirage revolutionized the Las Vegas Strip by introducing the megaresort concept, combining gaming with extravagant entertainment and attractions. It set a new standard for luxury and customer service in the hospitality industry and played a key role in transforming Las Vegas into a global tourist destination.
Notable_Visitors: The Beatles (through Cirque du Soleil's Love show)

Notable_Attractions: Siegfried & Roy's Secret Garden and Dolphin Habitat

world knowledge.Name: Tulalip Resort Casino
world knowledge.Area: Quil Ceda Village, Washington, United States
world knowledge.Address: 10200 Quil Ceda Blvd, Quil Ceda Village, Washington, United States
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Tulalip Resort Casino is an Indian casino and resort owned and operated by the Tulalip Tribes of Washington. It opened in 2003 as the Tulalip Casino, replacing an earlier casino that opened in 1992. A 12-story hotel was added in 2008, and the casino was renamed to Tulalip Resort Casino. The resort has undergone renovations and expansions, including a planned expansion between 2023 and 2025.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened in June 2003, replacing an earlier casino from 1992.
A 12-story hotel with 370 rooms was opened on August 15, 2008.
The hotel was renovated and awarded AAA Three Diamond status.
The casino began hosting an annual display of Christmas lights, featuring 7.8 million lights, an ice skating rink, and indigenous-owned vendor stalls.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort includes a 12-story hotel, one of the tallest buildings in Snohomish County, and features 192,000 square feet of gaming space, seven restaurants, a spa, and meeting rooms. The outdoor Tulalip Amphitheatre is used for entertainment events.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Tulalip Resort Casino is culturally significant as it is owned and operated by the Tulalip Tribes of Washington, representing Native American heritage and economic development. It also hosts cultural events like the annual Christmas lights display, which includes indigenous-owned vendor stalls.
world knowledge.Details: The resort features seven restaurants: Blackfish, Cedars Cafe, The Draft Bar and Grill, Journeys East, Canoes Carvery, Blazing Paddles, and Tula Bene. The casino has a parking lot with 5,740 stalls and is planned to be expanded between 2023 and 2025.

world knowledge.Name: Viejas Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Viejas Casino & Resort is owned by the Viejas Band of Kumeyaay Indians. The tribe purchased the reservation in 1932 with proceeds from a forced eviction from the El Capitan Reservoir area. The casino opened in 1991, and the resort has undergone multiple expansions and renovations since then.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened its doors on September 13, 1991, featuring gaming facilities and a bingo room.
A $19 million project to remodel the casino was completed.
The Viejas tribe announced an $800 million expansion project including a second casino, hotel, and parking garage.
The original hotel with 128 rooms opened in March 2013, and the property was renamed Viejas Casino & Resort.
An additional hotel tower with 109 deluxe rooms and luxury suites was completed, increasing total accommodations to 237 rooms and suites.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of the Willows Hotel & Spa
Major_Events.Description: The Willows Hotel & Spa, a luxury hotel tower for adults only, was completed with 159 suites, a spa, and upscale dining options.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features modern amenities, streamlined design, and a boutique feel. It includes multiple hotel towers, a large gaming floor, and various dining and entertainment venues.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Viejas Casino & Resort is significant as it is owned and operated by the Viejas Band of Kumeyaay Indians, representing their economic development and cultural resilience. It also serves as a major entertainment and hospitality hub in Southern California.
world knowledge.Details: The resort features over 2,000 slot machines, up to 86 table games, multiple restaurants, a deli, bingo, an off-track betting facility, a lounge, the largest outdoor ice rink in Southern California, concert venues, and meeting spaces. It has received the AAA Four Diamond Award consecutively since 2013. The resort also includes a 15 MW solar panel microgrid and a 410-stall charging station.

world knowledge.Name: Marina Bay Sands
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Marina Bay Sands is an integrated resort fronting Marina Bay in Singapore and a landmark of the city. At its opening in 2010, it was deemed the world's most expensive standalone casino property at S$8 billion (US$6.88 billion). The resort includes a 2,561-room hotel, a 120,000-square-metre convention-exhibition centre, the 74,000-square-metre The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands mall, a museum, a large theatre, "celebrity chef" restaurants, two floating crystal pavilions, art-science exhibits, and the world's largest atrium casino with 500 tables and 1,600 slot machines. The complex includes three towers topped by the Sands Skypark, a skyway connecting 340-metre-long with a capacity of 3,902 people and a 150 m infinity swimming pool, set on top of the world's largest public cantilevered platform, which overhangs the north tower by 66.5 m.

Major_Events.Description: The casino and parts of the resort opened to the public.
The resort and SkyPark were officially opened as part of a two-day celebration.
The full completion of the integrated resort was marked by the opening of the ArtScience Museum and the debut of the Wonder Full light show.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort is designed by Moshe Safdie, featuring three 55-storey hotel towers connected by the Sands SkyPark, a skyway with a cantilevered platform. The design includes a four-storey central atrium in the casino, a 19,000 m² ArtScience Museum, and a convention centre with 110,000 m² of space. The SkyPark includes a 146-metre infinity pool, gardens, and a public observatory deck.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Marina Bay Sands is a symbol of Singapore's economic and tourism growth, designed to meet the country's objectives for the next decade. It is one of two winning proposals for Singapore's first integrated resorts, contributing significantly to the local economy and tourism industry.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Integrated Resort (Casino, Hotel, Convention Centre, Shopping Mall, Museum, Theatre, Restaurants)
world knowledge.Details: Marina Bay Sands is owned by Las Vegas Sands in agreement with the Singaporean authorities. The resort was originally set to open in 2009 but faced delays due to escalating costs and the 2007–2008 financial crisis. It was opened in phases, with the final phase completed in 2011. The resort features a wide range of attractions, including the Sands SkyPark, The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, the ArtScience Museum, and multiple celebrity chef restaurants. The resort has also been involved in various legal and regulatory issues, including investigations into anti-money laundering practices and disputes over jackpot winnings.

world knowledge.Name: Golden Gate Hotel and Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Golden Gate Hotel & Casino is the oldest hotel in Las Vegas, originally opened as the Miller Hotel in 1905 and later renamed Hotel Nevada in 1906. It became Sal Sagev in 1931 and was renamed Golden Gate Hotel and Casino in 1974. The property has been a continuously operating hotel since 1906 and a casino since 1955.

Major_Events.Description: The hotel opened as the first concrete hotel in southern Nevada, with rooms costing $1 per day.
The casino ceased operations due to a statewide gambling ban.
The property was expanded and renamed Sal Sagev (Las Vegas spelled backwards).
The Golden Gate casino opened on the ground floor of the Sal Sagev hotel.

Major_Events.Event: Renaming to Golden Gate Hotel and Casino
Major_Events.Description: The entire property was renamed after the casino bought the hotel.
A $12 million renovation included a new hotel tower, expanded casino floor, and modernized facilities.
The casino doubled in size and added new slot machines and a sportsbook.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Originally a two-story concrete structure, expanded to three and four stories in 1931. The exterior was covered in aluminum siding in 1965, removed in 1990. The 2012 renovation introduced a modern look with a five-story hotel tower.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Golden Gate is the oldest continuously operating hotel in Las Vegas and introduced the fifty-cent shrimp cocktail, now a Las Vegas cliché. It represents the evolution of Las Vegas from a small desert town to a global entertainment hub.
world knowledge.Details: The Golden Gate was the first to serve a fifty-cent shrimp cocktail in 1959. The property has undergone multiple renovations, including in 1906, 1931, 1955, 1964, 2005, 2012, and 2017. It is part of the Fremont Street Experience and features a 1930s San Francisco theme.

world knowledge.Name: Kansas Crossing Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Kansas Crossing Casino + Hotel is a casino and hotel in Pittsburg, Kansas. Owned by Equity Ventures, JNB Gaming, and Laham Development, the property is operated by JNB Gaming and was built for US$80 million. Opened in 2017, it is located at the intersection of U.S. Highway 69 and U.S. Highway 400. In 2007, the state of Kansas enacted the Kansas Expanded Lottery Act, which included authorization for four casinos to be built and managed by private developers, under contract with the Kansas Lottery. On June 23, 2015, the Kansas Racing and Gaming Commission voted to award the Kansas Crossing Casino + Hotel a license to build just south of Pittsburg, Kansas. The Kansas Crossing Casino beat out two other proposals including the Castle Rock Casino plan from Wichita businessmen Rodney and Brandon Steven as well as Camptown Casino proposed by billionaire Phil Ruffin of Las Vegas. This was the fourth such license awarded in the state of Kansas.

Major_Events.Description: Celebrated its grand opening on April 8, 2017 with a performance from musician Jerrod Niemann.
Committed $4.5 million over 10 years to support the Southeast Kansas Career and Technical Education Center (CTEC), Pittsburg State University, and the Crawford County Convention & Visitors Bureau.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Southeast Kansas' historical mining theme
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is culturally significant as it was one of the four casinos authorized by the Kansas Expanded Lottery Act of 2007, contributing to the local economy and tourism.
world knowledge.Details: The Kansas Crossing Casino + Hotel opened with over 625 slot machines, 16 table games, a 123-room Hampton Inn & Suites, Two Brothers Mining Company restaurant, and an indoor/outdoor entertainment venue called The Corral.

world knowledge.Name: Desert Inn
world knowledge.Address: 3145 South Las Vegas Blvd, Paradise, NV, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Desert Inn was a historic hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip, opened in 1950 by Wilbur Clark with funding from Moe Dalitz and the Cleveland Syndicate. It was the fifth resort on the Strip and became famous for its opulence, high-profile guests, and entertainment. Howard Hughes purchased it in 1967 and lived there for years. After multiple ownership changes, it was demolished in 2000 to make way for Wynn Las Vegas.

Major_Events.Description: The Desert Inn opened with a heavily publicized two-day gala featuring celebrities and journalists, marking the beginning of its prominence in Las Vegas.
Howard Hughes bought the Desert Inn after refusing to leave his extended stay, marking the start of his Las Vegas real estate acquisitions.
The hotel celebrated its 50th anniversary with a week-long event, including a celebrity golf tournament and burial of a time capsule.
The hotel's towers were imploded to make way for Wynn Las Vegas, marking the end of an era for old Las Vegas.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed by Hugh Taylor with a 'southwestern spa' theme, featuring redwood interiors, flagstone flooring, and a Joshua tree cactus logo. Expansions included the St. Andrews Tower (1963), Augusta Tower (1978), and Palms Tower (1997). The 1997 renovation gave it a Mediterranean exterior with white stucco and red clay tile roofs.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Desert Inn was a symbol of old Las Vegas, known for its luxury, high-profile guests, and entertainment. It hosted legendary performers like Frank Sinatra and was a favorite among locals. Its closure marked the end of an era in Las Vegas history.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Hotel and casino, later including a country club and golf course.

Details.Golf_Course: Hosted the PGA Tour Tournament of Champions (1953-1966) and other major tournaments.
Details.Entertainment: Featured performances by Frank Sinatra, Noël Coward, Bobby Darin, and others. The Painted Desert Room (later Crystal Room) was a premier venue.
Details.Ownership_History: Owned by Moe Dalitz, Howard Hughes, Kirk Kerkorian, ITT Sheraton, Starwood, and finally Steve Wynn.
Details.Demolition: Imploded in 2001-2004 to build Wynn Las Vegas.
Details.Pop_Culture: Featured in films like 'Ocean's 11', 'Lost in America', and TV shows like 'Vega$' and 'Dynasty'.

world knowledge.Name: Coeur d'Alene Casino
world knowledge.Area: Coeur d'Alene Reservation, Kootenai County, Idaho
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Coeur d'Alene Casino is a Native American gaming enterprise run by the Coeur d'Alene people on the Coeur d'Alene Reservation. It began as a bingo hall in 1993 and has since expanded into a major resort with a casino, hotels, golf club, and restaurants. The project was initially managed by Dave Matheson, who also served as tribal chairman and deputy commissioner of Indian Affairs. The casino has undergone multiple expansions and renovations, becoming one of the largest employers in the Idaho region.

Major_Events.Description: The Coeur d'Alene people inaugurated a 20,000 square-feet bingo hall with an initial cost of $2.7 million.
Dave Matheson and Robert A. Berman initiated the National Indian Lottery, the first multi-state lottery, to generate funds for the casino's development.
The casino received a $14 million expansion.
The National Indian Lottery concluded after opposition from Attorney General Skip Humphrey.
Francis SiJohn became the casino's new CEO.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort includes two hotel towers, the Circling Raven Golf Club, multiple restaurants, and a 100,000 square feet casino floor space. The design reflects Native American cultural themes.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is culturally significant as it is owned and operated by the Coeur d'Alene people, with profits reinvested into the community for education, finance, and land investments. It represents Native American entrepreneurship and self-sufficiency.
world knowledge.Details: The casino features 2,000 gaming machines (video poker, ShuffleMaster electronic tables, slots, and keno), a bingo hall, entertainment venues, retail areas, and multiple restaurants. It also includes a luxury hotel and the award-winning Circling Raven Golf Club.

image_name: Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino Hollywood

world knowledge.Name: Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino Hollywood
world knowledge.Address: 1 Seminole Way Hollywood Reservation, Broward County, Florida 33314
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood is an integrated resort on the Hollywood Reservation of the Seminole Tribe of Florida. It opened on May 1, 2004, and underwent a major expansion completed in October 2019, including the addition of a guitar-shaped tower. The resort has grown into a major gambling and entertainment destination, featuring a casino, multiple hotel towers, dining, nightlife, and event spaces.

Major_Events.Description: The 69th edition of the Miss Universe competition was held here, where Andrea Meza of Mexico was crowned.
The new Hard Rock Live theater opened with a concert by Maroon 5 on October 25, 2019.
The resort's expansion was completed in advance of Super Bowl LIV held in Miami.
Model Anna Nicole Smith died in her hotel suite due to an accidental drug overdose.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features a 450-foot tower designed to resemble a pair of back-to-back Gibson Les Paul guitars, with LED lights simulating guitar strings. The property includes multiple hotel towers, a lagoon-style pool facility, and a large casino. The entrance is marked by a 50-foot tall guitar sculpture.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The resort is a symbol of the Seminole Tribe's economic success and cultural resilience. It is also a major entertainment hub, hosting high-profile events like the Miss Universe competition and concerts by world-famous artists. Its guitar-shaped design pays homage to rock and roll culture.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Integrated resort offering gambling, entertainment, dining, and hospitality services.
world knowledge.Details: The resort includes a 140,000 sq ft casino, a 7,000-seat Hard Rock Live theater, a Rock Spa, and over 20 dining and nightlife venues. It is owned by the Seminole Tribe of Florida and has undergone significant expansions, including a $1.3 billion project completed in 2019.

world knowledge.Name: Mark Twain Casino La Grange
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Mark Twain Casino opened on July 21, 2005, and was initially operated by Grace Entertainment. It was one of three Midwest casinos acquired from Grace Entertainment in 2005 for $287 million. The casino underwent a name change to Terrible's Mark Twain Casino when Herbst Gaming took over, but reverted to its original name in May 2011 when Herbst Gaming changed its name to Affinity Gaming.

Major_Events.Description: Mark Twain Casino was acquired by Herbst Gaming, leading to a name change to Terrible's Mark Twain Casino.
Herbst Gaming changed its name to Affinity Gaming, and the casino reverted to its original name, dropping 'Terrible's'.
Michael Silberling was named CEO of Affinity Gaming in August 2014.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Riverboat casino with a gaming floor featuring over 400 slot machines, video poker, and electronic table games.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is a notable entertainment venue in Northeast Missouri, contributing to the local economy and tourism.
world knowledge.Details: The property includes an RV park and features the Fireside Sports Bar & Grill. It is owned by Affinity Interactive and is located on the Mississippi River.

world knowledge.Name: Nevada Landing Hotel and Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Nevada Landing was a hotel and casino designed to resemble two riverboats. It opened in 1989 and was owned by MGM Resorts International.
