The property was typically marketed with its sister hotel, the Gold Strike Hotel and Gambling Hall, located across the I-15 freeway. The casino was built by a partnership that included David Belding, Mike Ensign, and William Richardson. It was first owned by Gold Strike Resorts and was sold to Circus Circus Enterprises in 1995, which later became Mandalay Resort Group in 1999. In 2004, it was acquired by MGM Mirage.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened in 1989, built by a partnership that included David Belding, Mike Ensign, and William Richardson.
The property was sold to Circus Circus Enterprises.
Circus Circus Enterprises became Mandalay Resort Group.
Mandalay Resort Group was acquired by MGM Mirage.
The hotel casino closed on March 20, 2007.
Demolition began on the hotel in early March 2008. By April 2008, the hotel was no longer standing.
The tall Nevada Landing sign by Interstate 15 was demolished.

Major_Events.Event: Sale and redevelopment of the site
Major_Events.Description: The site along with several large adjoining parcels were sold to a developer and are being developed into a 3 million square foot mega-warehouse complex.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed to resemble two riverboats.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Nevada Landing was a notable hotel and casino in Jean, Nevada, known for its riverboat theme and its role in the local gaming and hospitality industry.
world knowledge.Details: The property had 303 hotel rooms, four restaurants, over 800 slot machines (including video poker), live keno, table games, banquet facilities, and wedding services. It was typically marketed with its sister hotel, the Gold Strike Hotel and Gambling Hall.

world knowledge.Name: City of Dreams Manila
world knowledge.Address: Asean Avenue corner Roxas Boulevard, Entertainment City, Parañaque, Metro Manila, Philippines
world knowledge.Historical_Background: City of Dreams Manila is a luxury integrated resort and casino complex developed by Melco Resorts and Entertainment (Philippines) Corporation, a subsidiary of Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited. It is part of the Entertainment City gaming strip and is the second of four-billion-dollar casinos in Manila's gaming strip after Solaire Resort & Casino.

Major_Events.Description: The resort had its soft opening on December 14, 2014.

The grand opening on February 2, 2015, featured live performances from local and international acts such as Gary Valenciano, Zsa Zsa Padilla, Ne-Yo, and Kelly Rowland, dubbed as the 'Concert of Dreams'.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort consists of six hotel towers with a dome-like structure called Fortune Egg. It features a shopping strip called The Shops at The Boulevard and a theme park called DreamWorks DreamPlay.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: City of Dreams Manila is a significant landmark in the Philippines' entertainment and tourism industry, offering luxury accommodations, gaming, and entertainment options. It is a sister resort to City of Dreams in Macau and contributes to the economic growth of the region.

Details.No. of rooms: 938 (Hyatt Regency Hotel: 363, Nobu Hotel: 321, Nüwa Hotel: 254)
Details.Owner: Melco Resorts and Entertainment, Belle Corporation

image_name: Angel of the Winds Casino Resort

world knowledge.Name: Angel of the Winds Casino Resort
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Angel of the Winds Casino Resort is a casino and hotel operated by the Stillaguamish Tribe of Indians. The tribe, federally recognized in 1976, became a party to the Treaty of Point Elliott of 1855. The casino opened in 2004 as a temporary modular building and underwent expansions in 2008 and 2015, adding more gaming space and a hotel. The casino was built under Washington's enhanced tribal gambling law and faced initial opposition from local residents.

Major_Events.Description: The Angel of the Winds Casino opened on October 28, 2004, with 425 slot machines and 10 to 12 game tables.
A $44 million expansion increased the number of slot machines to 1,000 and the interior space to 57,000 square feet (5,300 m²).
A $27 million expansion added a five-story hotel with 125 rooms and a smoke shop.
The Stillaguamish Tribe signed a 10-year, $3.4 million naming rights deal to sponsor the Angel of the Winds Arena in Everett.

The casino was closed for two months during the COVID-19 pandemic and became the first in Western Washington to reopen on May 13, 2020, with limited capacity and temperature checks. A no-smoking policy was introduced.
Heritage Distilleries opened a bar and distillery inside the casino, the first distillery in a Washington casino under a 2018 federal law allowing tribes to distill alcohol on reservations.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Initially a modular building, later expanded with permanent structures including a five-story hotel and gaming space. The design evolved from temporary to permanent facilities.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is significant as it represents the economic development and self-sufficiency of the Stillaguamish Tribe, providing revenue and employment. It also marks the tribe's reservation, approved by the Bureau of Indian Affairs in 2014.
world knowledge.Details: The casino was initially funded by a $19 million loan from Marshall Bank after delays with a Las Vegas investor. It has faced competition from nearby casinos but has continued to grow. A $60 million expansion program announced in 2018 added more gaming space, a restaurant, and a parking garage. The casino was the first in Western Washington to reopen after COVID-19 closures.

image_name: Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races

world knowledge.Name: Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races is a casino, hotel, and Thoroughbred horse racing complex. It opened on December 2, 1933, as the first horse track in West Virginia following the legalization of parimutuel wagering. Developed by the Shenandoah Valley Jockey Club, it became America's first winter race meet. The facility thrived through World War II and underwent several ownership changes and upgrades, including the addition of slot machines, table games, and a hotel. It was rebranded as Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races in 2010.

Major_Events.Description: The track opened as the first horse racing facility in West Virginia, becoming America's first winter race meet.
Voters approved video lottery machines, revitalizing the struggling track.
County voters approved table games, leading to the rebranding as Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races.
Four open stakes worth a total of $500,000 were introduced.

Major_Events.Event: Inauguration of the Charles Town Classic
Major_Events.Description: A high-stakes race for older horses with a purse ranging from $500,000 to $1,500,000.
Hollywood Casino became the first in West Virginia to offer sports betting.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The facility includes a racetrack, casino, hotel, and event center. The property features a 153-room hotel, multiple dining options, and a gaming space of over 511,000 sq ft.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The landmark is significant as the first horse racing track in West Virginia and a major entertainment hub in the region. It has hosted notable guests and high-profile events, contributing to the local economy and culture.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Entertainment (casino, horse racing, hotel, and event hosting)
world knowledge.Details: The property includes The Inn at Charles Town, several dining facilities, and an event center for live concerts. It has faced competition from Maryland casinos since 2012. The facility is owned by Gaming and Leisure Properties and operated by Penn Entertainment.

world knowledge.Name: Kansas Star Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Kansas Star Casino was established following the Kansas Expanded Lottery Act of 2007, which authorized four state-owned casinos. After multiple bidding processes and local referendums, Peninsula Gaming was selected to develop the casino in Mulvane. The temporary facility opened in 2011, and the permanent facility opened in 2012. The casino includes a hotel and an arena, which was converted from the temporary casino building.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened in a temporary facility on December 26, 2011.
The permanent casino facility opened in December 2012.
The hotel expanded to 300 rooms in August 2014.

Major_Events.Event: Inaugural concert at Kansas Star Arena
Major_Events.Description: Daughtry performed at the inaugural concert in June 2013.
The casino was mandated to close on March 17, 2020, due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It reopened on May 22, 2020, with reduced capacity and safety measures.
The casino held a vaccine event offering Pfizer and Moderna vaccines on January 26, 2021.
The Wichita Force indoor football team officially relocated to the Kansas Star Arena in 2021.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The casino includes a hotel, a multipurpose arena, and several eateries and bars. The arena, converted from the temporary casino building, seats up to 5,000 people and features the Fire Club, a 3,200-square-foot skybox with a bar and patio.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Kansas Star Casino is a significant entertainment and gaming destination in Kansas, hosting concerts, sporting events, and other cultural activities. It plays a key role in the local economy and tourism.
world knowledge.Details: The casino has faced legal and financial challenges, including tax assessment disputes and competition from new casinos. It has also adapted to public health measures during the COVID-19 pandemic. The property includes a steakhouse, an Asian restaurant, and a buffet.

world knowledge.Name: The Cromwell Las Vegas
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as the Barbary Coast in 1979 by Michael Gaughan, the property underwent several ownership changes and renovations before becoming The Cromwell in 2014. It is now a luxury boutique hotel and casino owned by Caesars Entertainment.

Major_Events.Description: The Barbary Coast opened on March 2, 1979, featuring Victorian décor and a popular casino.

Major_Events.Event: Renamed Bill's Gamblin' Hall and Saloon
Major_Events.Description: After being acquired by Harrah's Entertainment, the property was renamed in honor of company founder Bill Harrah.

Major_Events.Event: Renovation and Reopening as The Cromwell
Major_Events.Description: The property underwent extensive renovations and reopened as The Cromwell, a luxury boutique hotel with a rooftop pool and nightclub.
The Cromwell was closed due to the COVID-19 pandemic and later reopened as an adults-only property.

Major_Events.Event: Planned Rebranding as The Vanderpump Hotel
Major_Events.Description: The property is expected to rebrand as The Vanderpump Hotel in partnership with television personality Lisa Vanderpump.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Cromwell features classic and modern French designs, inspired by Parisian apartments and the Hôtel Costes in Paris. The building includes a rooftop nightclub and a 40,010 sq ft casino.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Cromwell is a notable landmark on the Las Vegas Strip, known for its luxury boutique hotel experience, rooftop nightclub, and historical transformations from the Barbary Coast to its current form.
world knowledge.Details: The Cromwell includes 188 hotel rooms, a 40,010 sq ft casino, and notable attractions such as Drai's Beach Club & Nightclub and Giada's restaurant. It was the last resort on the Las Vegas Strip to reopen after the COVID-19 pandemic and will rebrand as The Vanderpump Hotel in early 2026.

world knowledge.Name: Tropicana Laughlin
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Tropicana Laughlin, originally named Ramada Express, opened in June 1988. It underwent expansions and renovations in 1993, 2007, 2009, 2012, 2015, and 2017. It was renamed Tropicana Express in 2007 and later Tropicana Laughlin in 2009. The property was acquired by Gaming and Leisure Properties (GLP) in 2018, with Caesars Entertainment operating it.

Major_Events.Description: The property opened under the name Ramada Express.
The expansion included the Promenade Tower, Town Square area, additional casino space, restaurants, and a parking garage.
The hotel was renamed Tropicana Express on July 28, 2007.
The hotel was renamed Tropicana Laughlin.

Major_Events.Event: Acquisition by GLP and Caesars Entertainment
Major_Events.Description: Gaming and Leisure Properties acquired the real estate, and Caesars Entertainment acquired the operating business.
The Tropicana's buffet closed permanently.
Tropicana Entertainment donated the rolling stock to the Las Vegas Railroad Society.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The hotel features a 12-story Casino Tower and a 24-story Promenade Tower. The lobby and casino floor were originally decorated in a railroad theme with historical railroad artifacts. The property includes the Pavilion Theater, Tango's Lounge, Eclipse Bar, and Grand Junction slot lounge.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Tropicana Laughlin is a significant landmark in Laughlin, Nevada, known for its casino and entertainment offerings. Its former railroad theme and memorabilia highlighted historical railroad lines in the United States.
world knowledge.Details: The Tropicana Laughlin has 1,498 guest rooms and suites, 1,050 slot machines, and 21 table games. It includes restaurants such as The Steakhouse, Passaggio Italian Gardens, Carnegie's Café, Taqueria Del Rio, Poolside Café, Dips & Dogs, and Victory Plaza. The property formerly operated a narrow gauge train with railroad-themed decor, which has since been removed.

world knowledge.Name: Paradise Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Paradise Casino is a small tribal casino located on the Fort Yuma Indian Reservation, straddling the Arizona–California state line. It was built by the Quechan Tribe after signing a compact with Arizona in 1993, opening in 1996. A second casino was later added in California in 2002 to offer blackjack, which was not allowed in Arizona at the time. The California casino was later closed in 2009 and converted into an event center, while the Arizona casino underwent renovations in 2011.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened to tribe members on July 31, 1996, and to the general public the next day.
A second casino opened in California on December 20, 2002, offering blackjack and additional slot machines.
The California casino was closed and converted into the Paradise Event Center after the opening of Quechan Casino Resort.
The Arizona casino underwent a major renovation.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Paradise Casino is culturally significant as a tribal casino owned and operated by the Quechan Tribe, contributing to the local economy and preserving tribal sovereignty through gaming operations.
world knowledge.Details: The casino was initially built at a cost of $13 million. The Paradise Event Center, converted from the former California casino, hosts concerts and events. The website is paradise-casinos.com.

world knowledge.Name: Hollywood Casino York
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The York Galleria is an enclosed shopping center that opened in 1989. It has undergone several transformations, including the addition of new retail stores, a casino, and fitness facilities. The mall has adapted to changing retail trends by repurposing spaces formerly occupied by anchor tenants like JCPenney, The Bon-Ton, and Sears.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of Target, Kohl's, and Michaels
Major_Events.Description: Three new retail stores opened next to York Galleria: Target, Kohl's, and Michaels. Kohl's opened on April 16, 1999, and Target opened on October 10, 1999.
JCPenney closed as part of a strategy to optimize its brick-and-mortar format. The space was reconstructed for additional specialty retailers, including H&M, Marshalls, and PA Fitness.
The Bon-Ton closed after failing to establish new conditions to satisfy its long-term debt. The space was transformed into an Extra Space Storage facility.
Sears closed as part of an ongoing decision to phase out its traditional brick-and-mortar format. The lower level was reconstructed for Hollywood Casino York.
Hollywood Casino York opened on August 12, 2021, after delays due to the coronavirus pandemic. It features up to 750 slot machines and 30 table games.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The York Galleria is a two-story enclosed shopping mall with a traditional retail layout, featuring anchor tenants, specialty retailers, and a food court. The mall has undergone several renovations to accommodate new tenants and facilities, including a casino and fitness center.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The York Galleria is a significant retail and entertainment hub in York County, Pennsylvania. Its adaptation to changing consumer preferences, including the addition of a casino, reflects broader trends in the retail and entertainment industries.
world knowledge.Details: The mall features retailers such as Boscov's, Marshalls, American Eagle Outfitters, H&M, Rue21, Francesca's, The Children's Place, and Victoria's Secret. The food court on the upper level contains counter service restaurants, and a Red Robin restaurant is located in the east-side parking lot. Public transit access is provided by rabbittransit bus routes 1E and 12.

world knowledge.Name: Comanche Nation Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Comanche Nation Casino, often known as Comanche Nation Entertainment, is a Native American casino geographically situated in the Southwest Great Plains Country of the United States. The gaming establishment, which opened in 2007, is operated and owned by the tribal sovereignty of the Comanche Nation of Oklahoma with the governing powers in Lawton.
world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Southwest Native American theme, designed by I-5 Design
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Operated and owned by the Comanche Nation of Oklahoma, representing tribal sovereignty and Native American culture.
world knowledge.Details: Also known as Comanche Nation Entertainment. Notable restaurants include Comanche Burger Company, Numunu Grill, and War Pony Brewery. Previous name: Comanche Nation Games.

world knowledge.Name: DraftKings at Casino Queen
world knowledge.Address: Near the Mississippi River in East St. Louis, Illinois
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Casino Queen was established as part of Illinois' 1990 riverboat casino law to aid the financially troubled city of East St. Louis. It opened on June 23, 1993, and was initially operated on a riverboat called the White Star One. Over the years, it transitioned to land-based operations while retaining a floating gaming floor. The casino has been a significant revenue source for East St. Louis, generating over $160 million between 1993 and 2009.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened as a riverboat casino under Illinois' riverboat casino law to support East St. Louis.
The casino moved inland but kept the gaming floor floating on a water-filled basin to comply with regulations.

Major_Events.Event: Rebranding to DraftKings at Casino Queen
Major_Events.Description: The casino partnered with DraftKings for sports betting and underwent a $10 million renovation.
The casino's parent company merged with Bally's Corporation.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Originally a riverboat casino, the gaming floor now floats on a basin filled with 340,000 gallons of water. The property includes a 38,000 sq ft gaming space, a 157-room hotel, and a 133-space RV Park.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Casino Queen has been a vital economic driver for East St. Louis, providing employment and revenue to the struggling city. It represents the evolution of gaming laws in Illinois and the transition from riverboat to land-based casinos.

Details.Public_Transit_Access: Blue Red at East Riverfront (MetroLink light rail system)

world knowledge.Name: Crown Perth
world knowledge.Address: Great Eastern Highway Burswood WA 6100 Australia
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Crown Perth, originally known as Burswood Island Casino, was proposed in 1984 by Perth businessman Dallas Dempster and constructed on Burswood Island, a former landfill site. It opened on 30 December 1985 as the largest casino in Australia and the third-largest in the world. Over the years, it underwent several renovations and expansions, including the addition of hotels, convention centers, and entertainment facilities. The complex was rebranded as Crown Perth in 2011.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened as the largest in Australia and third-largest in the world, attracting significant public interest and high profits.
Michael Jackson performed three sold-out shows at Burswood Dome, attracting 60,000 attendees.
The complex was rebranded as Crown Perth, aligning with its sister properties under Crown Resorts Limited.
A luxury 500-room hotel was added to the complex, increasing its total hotel capacity to 1,200 rooms.
A contractor entered cricket player Virat Kohli's room uninvited and uploaded a video to social media, leading to an apology and termination by Crown Perth.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features futuristic-looking buildings, a casino, convention center, theaters, ballrooms, multiple restaurants, and three hotels (Crown Metropol Perth, Crown Promenade Perth, and Crown Towers Perth). The design incorporates recreational facilities and beautified parklands.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Crown Perth is a major entertainment and tourism hub in Western Australia, contributing to the local economy and offering a wide range of leisure and hospitality services. It is one of three Crown Resorts in Australia and holds a monopoly on casino operations in Perth.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Entertainment and hospitality, including gambling, dining, accommodation, and events.

Gaming_Facilities.Electronic_Gaming_Machines: Present (no reel slot machines due to state laws)

Details.Parklands: Burswood Park, featuring wildflower displays, a heritage trail, and community events.

world knowledge.Name: Cherokee Casino (Roland)
world knowledge.Address: Near the Oklahoma-Arkansas state line, I-40, and US Highway 64, Exit 325
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Owned and operated by Cherokee Nation Entertainment, a division of Cherokee Nation Businesses (a wholly owned subsidiary of the Cherokee Nation).
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is part of the Cherokee Nation's business ventures, contributing to the economic development of the Cherokee Nation.
world knowledge.Details: The casino is open 24 hours a day and features 850 gaming machines, 9 table games including blackjack and poker variations, and an onsite restaurant called The Buffet. There are 120 non-smoking hotel rooms, including 12 suites. It is located 10 minutes from Ft. Smith, Arkansas.

world knowledge.Name: Ocean Downs
world knowledge.Address: 10218 Race Track Road, Berlin, Maryland, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Ocean Downs is a casino and harness racing track that opened in 1949. It has undergone multiple ownership changes, financial struggles, and expansions, including the addition of a casino in 2011. Initially built for harness racing, it has remained a significant venue in Maryland's racing industry.

Major_Events.Description: Ocean Downs opened as a harness racing track on July 25, 1949, after construction delays.

Major_Events.Event: Bankruptcy and sale to Frederick Weisman
Major_Events.Description: Ocean Downs went into bankruptcy and was sold to California entrepreneur Frederick Weisman.
Bally Entertainment purchased Ocean Downs, hoping for the legalization of slot machines in Maryland.
Maryland voters approved slot machines, leading to the construction of a $45-million casino at Ocean Downs.
The casino at Ocean Downs opened with 750 slot machines.
A 50,000-square-foot expansion added table games and a new restaurant.
William Rickman sold Ocean Downs to a joint venture of Churchill Downs Inc. and Saratoga Casino Holdings.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Ocean Downs is a historic harness racing track and one of the few venues in Maryland with a casino. It reflects the mid-20th-century surge in harness racing popularity and the evolution of gambling laws in the state.

world knowledge.Name: Saratoga Casino and Raceway
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened in 1941 as Saratoga Raceway for harness racing, it became the third racetrack with pari-mutuel wagering. The facility evolved with the addition of video lottery terminals (VLTs) in 2004 and a hotel in 2016. It has undergone several name changes reflecting its transformations, including Saratoga Equine Sports Center, Saratoga Gaming and Raceway, and Saratoga Casino and Raceway before settling on its current name.

Major_Events.Description: Saratoga Raceway became the first racing facility in New York to open VLTs to the public, marking a significant shift in its operations and revenue streams.
Dancin Yankee set a track and world record for aged pacing colts on a half-mile track with a time of 1:48:4.
A new hotel was constructed on the north end of the property, replacing a former training track.
The casino discontinued its annual July 3 fireworks display to join the city's July 4 celebrations at Congress Park.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The facility features a 1⁄2-mile oval harness racing track with a grandstand housing a casino, hotel, and various dining and entertainment venues. The infield is landscaped, giving it a country feel. The casino floor includes over 1,700 VLTs and electronic table games.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Saratoga Casino Hotel is a significant venue for harness racing in the U.S., hosting major events like the Joe Gerrity Jr. Pacing Series and the New York Sire Stakes Night of Champions. It has played a pivotal role in the local economy and entertainment scene, blending gaming, racing, and hospitality.
world knowledge.Details: The facility includes multiple dining options like Lucky Joe's, Garden Buffet, and Fortune's Restaurant, as well as bars and the Vapor Night Club for live entertainment. It also features the Saratoga Harness Hall of Fame. The casino operates on a voucher system for gaming payouts. The property has undergone several upgrades, including an $8 million renovation in 2019 to add an Outdoor Gaming Terrace, Sports Bar, and VIP Lounge.

world knowledge.Name: Jackpot Junction Casino Hotel
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Jackpot Junction Casino Hotel is the first casino in the state of Minnesota. It initially opened as a bingo hall in 1984 and later expanded to include slots and table games in 1988. Over the years, it has grown to include a hotel, convention center, golf course, and entertainment venues.

Major_Events.Description: Jackpot Junction opened as a bingo hall.

Major_Events.Event: Addition of slots and table games
Major_Events.Description: Slot machines and table games were added to the casino.
The Lower Sioux Lodge was added to the complex.
A convention center was added to the complex.

Major_Events.Event: Sponsorship of IMCA KSE Racing Products Sprint Cars tour
Major_Events.Description: The casino became the sponsor for the IMCA KSE Racing Products Sprint Cars tour.
An amphitheater was built.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of Dacotah Ridge Golf Club
Major_Events.Description: The Dacotah Ridge Golf Club opened.
The Lower Sioux Lodge expanded to 276 rooms.

Major_Events.Event: New convention center and hotel wing
Major_Events.Description: A new convention center was built, replacing the old one, and the Lower Sioux Lodge added a new wing, bringing its total number of hotel rooms to 379. The pool/spa area was also renovated, and the Carousel Buffet became Seasons Buffet.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The casino and hotel complex includes a 46,520 sq ft casino, a 379-room hotel, a 40-space recreational vehicle park, several restaurants, a convention center, a Rees Jones-designed golf course, and two live entertainment venues.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Jackpot Junction is culturally significant as the first casino in Minnesota and is owned and operated by the Lower Sioux Indian Community, contributing to the local economy and cultural preservation.
world knowledge.Details: Jackpot Junction has over 1,000 video slot machines as well as over 20 blackjack tables, including a 'High-Limit' area. The website for the casino is www.jackpotjunction.com.

world knowledge.Name: Circa Resort & Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Circa Resort & Casino is a casino and hotel resort in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada, on the Fremont Street Experience. The property was previously occupied by the Las Vegas Club hotel-casino, the Mermaids Casino, and the Glitter Gulch strip club. Circa is owned by brothers Derek and Greg Stevens, who purchased the Las Vegas Club in 2015, followed by the acquisition of Mermaids and Glitter Gulch. The three businesses were demolished in 2017, and construction on Circa began in February 2019, with an opening initially scheduled for December 2020. The COVID-19 pandemic caused disruptions, leading to an early opening of the first five floors on October 28, 2020, and the hotel portion on December 28, 2020.

Major_Events.Description: Brothers Derek and Greg Stevens purchased the Las Vegas Club, located at 18 Fremont Street in downtown Las Vegas.

Major_Events.Event: Purchase of Mermaids Casino and Glitter Gulch
Major_Events.Description: The Stevens purchased the nearby Mermaids Casino and the Glitter Gulch strip club, which were later demolished in 2017.
Construction on Circa began in February 2019, with a tight schedule due to the small size of the property.
The first five floors, including the casino and pool area, opened early on October 28, 2020, due to pandemic-related disruptions.
The hotel portion of Circa opened on December 28, 2020, with 512 rooms.
The hotel expanded to include an additional 106 rooms, bringing the total to 618.
President Donald Trump gave a speech at Circa on January 24, 2025.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Circa was designed by Steelman Partners and features a 480-foot-tall tower with 35 floors. The resort includes a two-story casino, a three-story sportsbook, and a six-tiered swimming pool area. The HVAC system dispenses air from the floor to eliminate cigarette smoke lingering on casino floors. The tower's north side features a giant video screen measuring 228 feet tall and 52 feet wide. The resort also includes a nine-story parking garage known as Garage Mahal, with 982 parking spaces and an air-conditioned skybridge connecting it to the resort.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Circa is the first new hotel-casino to be built in downtown's Fremont Street area since 1980. The resort pays homage to the history of Las Vegas, with references to past casino builders such as Benny Binion, Jackie Gaughan, Jay Sarno, and Sam Boyd. It features various forms of artwork, including murals, and incorporates the former Vegas Vickie cowgirl sign that once advertised Glitter Gulch. Circa is also the only property in the downtown area to have an AAA Four Diamond rating as of 2021.
world knowledge.Details: Circa includes a two-story casino with 1,350 slot machines and 49 table games. The resort's sportsbook is the largest in Las Vegas, with seating for 1,000 people and a three-story, high-definition 78 megapixel television screen. The rooftop pool area, known as Stadium Swim, includes six pools and a 143-foot screen. Circa has several restaurants, including Barry's Downtown Prime, Sagainaw's Delicatessen, Victory Burger, 8 East, and Project BBQ. The resort also features six bars and lounges, including the Legacy Club, which honors prominent Las Vegas figures with busts and a display of 500 gold bars.

world knowledge.Name: Vegas World
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Vegas World was a space-themed casino and hotel owned by Bob Stupak. It opened on July 13, 1979, after Stupak's previous casino on the same site burned down in 1974. The resort featured innovative gambling concepts, world records, and space-themed memorabilia. It closed on February 1, 1995, to be remodeled into the Stratosphere.

Major_Events.Event: Fire at Bob Stupak's World Famous Million-Dollar Historic Gambling Museum and Casino
Major_Events.Description: A fire destroyed Stupak's initial casino, suspected by insurers as arson, though the claim was later settled.
The space-themed casino and hotel opened with 90 rooms and a 15,000 sq ft casino.
Stuntman Dan Koko set two world records: a 'fire fall' and a 'high fall' from the hotel's rooftop.
High winds knocked over the world's largest exterior sign, causing a fire and temporary evacuation.
Vegas World closed to be remodeled and integrated into the Stratosphere resort.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Space-themed design with mirrored walls, black interiors, stars, and plastic columns with bubbling liquid. Featured a replica of the Apollo Lunar Module and life-sized astronaut hanging from the ceiling. The hotel had a spaceport-themed lobby and the world's largest mural.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Vegas World was known for its eccentric, space-themed design and innovative gambling offerings. It reflected Bob Stupak's flamboyant personality and was one of Las Vegas' most unusual casinos, often described as tacky yet iconic.
world knowledge.Details: Vegas World featured the world's first quarter-million and million-dollar slot machine jackpots, a giant Big Six wheel, and no-limit wagering. It was prominently featured in media, including '60 Minutes,' 'Crime Story,' and films like 'Fever Pitch.' Much of its memorabilia was later collected by Lonnie Hammargren.

world knowledge.Name: The Montage Reno
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened in 1978 as Sahara Reno, it operated as a hotel and casino under various names until 2005. It was converted into a condominium tower from 2006 to 2008. The property has undergone multiple ownership changes and renovations, transitioning from a gaming establishment to a residential building.

Major_Events.Description: The hotel-casino was originally opened as Sahara Reno, owned by the Del E. Webb Corporation.
The property was rebranded as Reno Hilton.

Major_Events.Event: Renovation and rebranding to Flamingo Hilton Reno
Major_Events.Description: The hotel underwent renovations and was renamed Flamingo Hilton Reno.
Hilton declined to renew its licensing agreement, leading to the name change to Flamingo Reno.
Park Place Entertainment closed the property due to declining profitability in the gaming market.
After renovation, the property reopened as Golden Phoenix Reno, featuring a hotel and later a casino.
Fernando Leal purchased the property, closed the Golden Phoenix, and converted it into a condominium tower named The Montage Reno.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Originally designed by David Jacobson Associates and constructed by the Del E. Webb Corporation. The renovation was handled by Antunovich Associates and Garofalo Architects. The building was gutted down to its concrete support columns and rebuilt as condominiums.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Montage Reno represents the transition of Reno's gaming and hospitality industry into modern residential developments. It has historical significance as a former major hotel-casino and now serves as a high-end residential property.
world knowledge.Details: The Montage Reno is now owned by ST Residential LLC, a subsidiary of Starwood Assets and Holdings. It offers exclusive condo amenities such as a 24-hour doorman, resort-style pool deck, and owners lounge. The property was featured in the movie 'The Cooler' during its time as the Golden Phoenix.

world knowledge.Name: Teller House
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Teller House is a historic hotel in Central City, Colorado, built in 1872. It now serves as a restaurant. The bar at the Teller House is well known for 'The Face on the Barroom Floor', a painting of a woman's face on the wooden floor, done in 1936 by local artist Herndon Davis as a joke after being fired by the Teller House.

Major_Events.Description: The building opened as a casino, which operated until 2000.
A new management company reopened the casino, but it closed again later that year.
The Teller House was added to the National Register of Historic Places on January 18, 1973.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Romanesque
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Teller House is historically significant as a historic hotel and for its association with the painting 'The Face on the Barroom Floor'. It is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
world knowledge.Details: This article about a property in Colorado on the National Register of Historic Places is a stub.

world knowledge.Name: Four Queens
world knowledge.Address: 202 East Fremont Street, Las Vegas, Nevada 89101
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Four Queens was developed by Ben Goffstein, who named it in reference to his four daughters. The casino opened on June 2, 1966, followed by the eight-story hotel two months later. The property has undergone several expansions and renovations over the years, including additions in 1969 and 1981. It was owned by Elsinore Corporation from 1973 to 2003, when it was sold to local businessman Terry Caudill.

Major_Events.Description: The casino portion opened on June 2, 1966, accompanied by a promotional giveaway with prizes totaling $250,000. The hotel opened on August 12, 1966.
The casino added the world's largest slot machine, known as the Queen's Machine, which measured 9 feet high, 18 feet long, and 8 feet wide.
A $20 million, multiyear renovation concluded in 2007, covering all hotel rooms and adding new dining establishments.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The original architect was Julius Gabriele. The hotel was designed to easily allow the addition of new rooms at a later point. The property includes a 690-room hotel and a 27,269 sq ft casino.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Four Queens is named after Ben Goffstein's four daughters, each considered a variation of the Queen playing card. It is a notable landmark in downtown Las Vegas and has been featured in films and television series.
world knowledge.Details: The Four Queens was among filming locations for the 2023 television series Obliterated. The property includes notable attractions such as the Queen's Machine and Hugo's Cellar restaurant. It is owned and operated through TLC Casino Enterprises.

world knowledge.Name: Green Valley Ranch
world knowledge.Address: 2300 Paseo Verde Parkway, Henderson, Nevada, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Green Valley Ranch is a hotel and casino located in Henderson, Nevada, owned and operated by Station Casinos. It was initially proposed by American Nevada Corporation in 1996, with construction beginning in 2000 after partnering with Station Casinos. The resort opened on December 18, 2001, with 201 rooms and a 50,000 sq ft casino. It was designed as an upscale locals casino, costing $300 million, the most expensive locals casino in Las Vegas history at the time. The resort has undergone several expansions and renovations, including a hotel expansion in 2005 and various updates in 2014-15 and 2023-24.

Major_Events.Description: The resort opened on December 18, 2001, with 201 rooms and a 50,000 sq ft casino, featuring a Mediterranean theme and upscale amenities.
A hotel expansion opened in 2005, increasing the room count to 497 and adding more meeting space and high-end suites.
Station Casinos took over full ownership of the resort in June 2011 after a $500 million purchase agreement.
In November 2017, employees voted for unionization through the Culinary Workers Union, with 78 percent of workers in favor.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Mediterranean-themed design with upscale elements, including a presidential suite, high-limit gaming area, and scenic landscaping. The resort features a 143,891 sq ft casino, multiple restaurants, a Regal Cinemas theater, and a spa.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Green Valley Ranch is significant as the most expensive locals casino in Las Vegas history at the time of its opening, blending upscale amenities with value-priced offerings. It has been a key part of the Green Valley Ranch community, contributing to the local economy and providing entertainment options for residents and tourists alike.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Hotel and casino, offering gaming, dining, entertainment, and accommodation services.
world knowledge.Details: The resort includes various amenities such as a 10-screen Regal Cinemas theater, a spa, multiple restaurants, and a pool area. It has hosted numerous entertainment events and was named 'casino of the year' by the Academy of Country Music in 2010. The resort continues to undergo renovations and updates to maintain its upscale appeal.

world knowledge.Name: Pechanga Resort and Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Pechanga Resort Casino is a Native American casino and integrated resort on the Pechanga Indian Reservation. The Pechanga tribe obtained additional land in 1907, named the Kelsey tract. The resort opened on June 24, 2002, designed to highlight the Pechanga Band of Luiseño Indians' culture. It has undergone several expansions, including in 2004 and a major $300 million expansion in 2018.

Major_Events.Description: The $262 million Pechanga Resort & Casino opened, featuring an 85,000 sq ft casino, 1,200-seat showroom, 522-room hotel, and convention center.
A 100,000 sq ft expansion added additional gaming space, a high-limit gaming area, a food court, a 54-table poker room, and a sports-themed restaurant.
A 27-month, $300 million expansion doubled the hotel room capacity to 1,090, expanded the spa facility, created a 40,000-square foot events center, and built a 4.5-acre tropical pool complex.
After the COVID-19 pandemic, the indoor property was made entirely smoke-free, with smoking permitted only in designated outdoor areas.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features a 14-story hotel, a 200,000 sq ft gaming space, a 4.5-acre pool complex, a luxury spa, and multiple entertainment venues. The design highlights the Pechanga Band of Luiseño Indians' culture.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The resort is culturally significant as it is owned and operated by the Pechanga Band of Luiseño Indians, showcasing their heritage and providing economic benefits to the tribe. It is also one of the largest casino/resorts in the United States.
world knowledge.Details: Pechanga Resort Casino features over 5,000 slot machines, 152 table games, a high-limit gaming area, and private gaming rooms. It includes 15 bars and restaurants, a 1,200-seat theater, a 40,000-square foot events center, and a golf course. The resort is the largest employer in Temecula Valley with nearly 4,500 employees.

world knowledge.Name: Ellis Island Casino & Brewery
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as the Village Pub in 1968 by Frank Ellis, it was renamed Ellis Island in 1985. A casino was added in 1989, and the property has remained a family business under Gary Ellis since 1990. The property expanded over the years, including the acquisition of an adjacent Super 8 hotel in 2014, and underwent several renovations.

Major_Events.Description: Frank Ellis opened the Village Pub as part of the Village Square shopping center.
The Village Pub was renamed Ellis Island.
A casino was added to Ellis Island on October 1, 1989.
A $12 million renovation doubled the slot machine count to 410 and added table games, a parking garage, and additional dining space.
Ellis Island purchased the adjacent Super 8 motel, rebranding it under the Ellis Island name and adding 301 rooms.
A two-story restaurant and entertainment venue, The Front Yard, opened on the property's northwest corner.

Ellis Island filed a lawsuit against the Las Vegas Grand Prix, Clark County, and Nevada for alleged monetary damages due to impeded access during the race setup. The case was dismissed in 2024, and Ellis Island later partnered with Grand Prix for future races.
The on-site brewery, operational since 1998, was dismantled to make way for additional casino space.
A $35 million expansion began, including rooftop event space and renovations to the Village Pub restaurant and karaoke lounge.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The property includes a casino, multiple restaurants, a hotel, and event spaces. The design has evolved over time with expansions and renovations, including the addition of a parking garage and The Front Yard venue.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Ellis Island is a family-owned business in a city dominated by corporate casinos. It is popular among locals for its affordable food, karaoke bar, and unique offerings like its alcoholic eggnog. The property also played a role in the local brewing industry before the on-site brewery was dismantled.
world knowledge.Details: Ellis Island is known for its cheap food, karaoke bar, and gaming rewards program. It produces a popular alcoholic eggnog based on a family recipe. The property was involved in the Las Vegas Grand Prix and later partnered with the event after a lawsuit was dismissed. The casino continues to expand, with recent projects including rooftop event space and restaurant renovations.

world knowledge.Name: Harrah's Laughlin
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Harrah's Laughlin, originally named Harrah's Del Rio, opened on August 29, 1988, with the 15-story South Tower and the 18-story Central Tower. The 20-story North Tower was completed in 1992. It is owned by Vici Properties and operated by Caesars Entertainment. In July 2020, Eldorado Resorts acquired Caesars Entertainment, taking over operations of the property. Vici Properties bought the real estate of Harrah's Laughlin for $435 million and leased it back to Eldorado (newly renamed as Caesars Entertainment).

Major_Events.Description: A fight between the Hells Angels and the Mongols during the annual Laughlin River Run, resulting in 3 deaths.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The hotel consists of three towers: the 15-story South Tower, the 18-story Central Tower, and the 20-story North Tower. The South Tower is adult-only, while the North and Central Towers serve as family towers.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Harrah's Laughlin is a significant casino hotel in Laughlin, Nevada, contributing to the local economy and tourism industry. It is also notable for its historical events and large-scale operations.

Details.Notable restaurants: Beach Café, Cinnabon, Fresh Market Square Buffet (until 2020), Guy Fieri's El Burro Borracho, Pin-Up Pizza, Smashburger, Starbucks, The Range Steakhouse

world knowledge.Name: Solaire Resort & Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Solaire Resort & Casino was the first development in PAGCOR's Entertainment City, envisioned by former PAGCOR Chairman Efraim Genuino for the Manila Bay area. It was built on a 120-hectare reclaimed area designated as a special economic zone. The resort was launched as 'Solaire Manila' in 2010 and renamed 'Solaire Resort & Casino' in 2012. Phase 1 was completed in 2013, and it was officially opened by President Benigno Aquino III on March 16, 2013.

Major_Events.Description: Solaire Manila broke ground in July 2010 as part of PAGCOR's Entertainment City project.
Solaire Resort & Casino was officially opened on March 16, 2013, by President Benigno Aquino III and other dignitaries.
Solaire Resort was awarded the Forbes Travel Guide 5-Star Excellence Award for the 8th consecutive year.
Bloomberry announced the opening of Solaire Resort North in Quezon City, a US$1-billion investment, on May 25, 2024.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed by Paul Steelman of Steelman Partners, the complex features two 17-storey hotels (Bay Tower and Sky Tower) with a total of 800 rooms, suites, and villas. It includes a column-free grand ballroom, function rooms, gaming areas, and retail spaces. The interior design was provided by DSAA, and lighting design by shop12.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Solaire Resort is a significant part of the Philippines' tourism and entertainment industry, contributing to the economy and providing world-class leisure and gaming facilities. It is also a symbol of modern development in the Manila Bay area.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Integrated resort offering gaming, hospitality, entertainment, dining, and retail services.
world knowledge.Details: The resort features 18,500 square meters of gaming space with 1,620 slot machines and 360 gaming tables. It includes 'The Shoppes at Solaire' mall, 'The Theatre at Solaire' with 1,740 seats, and multiple dining options. Solaire Resort North, opened in 2024, offers 530 guest rooms, a grand ballroom, and 10,000-hectare gaming space with luxury amenities.

world knowledge.Name: Island View Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Island View Casino is the successor to the Copa Casino, which was destroyed by Hurricane Katrina. After the hurricane, the owners rebuilt the casino on dry land, utilizing the former Grand Casino Gulfport's hotel temporarily. It is now the only remaining casino in Gulfport post-Katrina.

Major_Events.Description: The original Copa Casino and neighboring Grand Casino Gulfport were destroyed by Hurricane Katrina.
The new facility opened with 1,033 gaming machines, 15 table games, a buffet, a grill, and a 563-room hotel.
Added more gaming space, Emeril's Gulf Coast Fish House, and a multi-level parking garage.
Expanded accommodations to 970 guest rooms, with additional amenities like a spa, fitness center, and saltwater pool.
A $75-million casino was completed next to the Beach Tower.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The casino features a modern design with multiple phases of expansion, including gaming spaces, restaurants, and hotel towers. The Beach Tower includes a saltwater pool and meeting facilities.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: As the only remaining casino in Gulfport after Hurricane Katrina, it represents resilience and economic recovery for the region. It also contributes to local tourism and entertainment.
world knowledge.Details: The casino offers various amenities, including gaming, dining (e.g., Carter Green Steakhouse), a golf course (Windance Country Club), and a guest swimming pool. It underwent multiple renovations and expansions, with the latest casino addition completed in 2018.

world knowledge.Name: Pala Casino Resort and Spa
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Pala Casino Spa Resort is a casino hotel and spa owned and operated by the Pala Band of Mission Indians, a federally recognized tribe. Construction began in March 2000 and opened in April 2001. The resort expanded with additional facilities in 2003.

Major_Events.Description: The $115 million Pala Casino opened on April 3, 2001.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of Pala Casino Spa & Resort
Major_Events.Description: On August 19, 2003, Pala Casino Spa & Resort opened with 500 rooms, a spa, and a conference center. The project cost around $105 million to complete.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features a large casino floor, multiple entertainment venues, a spa, and a hotel with 500 rooms and 82 suites.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The resort is culturally significant as it is owned and operated by the Pala Band of Mission Indians, a federally recognized tribe, contributing to the local economy and preserving tribal heritage.

world knowledge.Name: Silver Nugget
world knowledge.Address: 2140 Las Vegas Boulevard North, North Las Vegas, Nevada 89030
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Silver Nugget was opened in 1964 by Major Riddle. In 1966, it became one of the first Las Vegas casinos to have female card dealers. It was purchased by Silver Nugget Gaming in January 2007 for $23.8 million, which included the Opera House Casino. The casino is currently owned and operated by Fifth Street Gaming, with Jeffrey Fine as the owner.

Major_Events.Description: The Silver Nugget became one of the first Las Vegas casinos to employ female card dealers.

The casino resumed boxing matches, an old tradition that had not been offered for many years in North Las Vegas. The first fight card was on September 30, 2008, with plans to continue featuring regional fighters.
The casino sold 12 acres (4.9 ha) of vacant land in the North Las Vegas redevelopment zone to the city of North Las Vegas.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The casino site includes a 14,000 sq ft (1,300 m2) arena and a 23,000 sq ft (2,100 m2) gaming space. It features a bowling center and a sports book operated by Leroy's Race & Sports Book.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Silver Nugget is significant for its role in Las Vegas gaming history, including being one of the first casinos to employ female card dealers and its contributions to local entertainment through boxing matches and other events.
world knowledge.Details: The casino offers a bowling center, Bingo, and a sports book. It is privately held, with Jeffrey Fine as the owner, who also owns several Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf locations. The casino's website is silvernuggetlv.com.

image_name: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Sioux City

world knowledge.Name: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Sioux City
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Sioux City was proposed in October 2012 as a $100-million project by Warner Gaming. It was developed with a boutique hotel component and opened on August 1, 2014, after being selected over competing bids for the casino license in Woodbury County. The casino is land-based, marking a shift from Iowa's previous riverboat casino requirement. Ownership has changed hands, initially from Warner Gaming to Peninsula Pacific Entertainment, and later to Churchill Downs, Inc. in 2022.

Major_Events.Description: The proposal for Hard Rock Casino Sioux City was announced, with Warner Gaming as the developer.
The Iowa Racing and Gaming Commission selected the Hard Rock over other proposals for the casino license.
The Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Sioux City officially opened on August 1, 2014.
Peninsula Pacific bought out Warner's stake in the property.
Peninsula Pacific sold the Hard Rock and other assets to Churchill Downs, Inc.
Hard Rock began accepting sports bets following the legalization of sports betting in Iowa.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The hotel is housed in the historic Battery Building, featuring a modern casino design with a gaming floor of 45,000 sq ft, including over 850 slot machines and 25 table games.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Sioux City represents a significant development in Sioux City's entertainment and tourism industry, contributing to the local economy and providing a venue for gaming, dining, and events.
world knowledge.Details: The property features two restaurants: Main + Abbey and Fuel American Grill. It also includes the Anthem Battery Park as a signature attraction. Sports betting was introduced in 2019, expanding its entertainment offerings.

world knowledge.Name: Wildhorse Resort & Casino
world knowledge.Address: 5 mi east of Pendleton, near Interstate 84, Umatilla Indian Reservation, Oregon
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Wildhorse Resort & Casino is owned and operated by the Confederated Tribes of the Umatilla Indian Reservation. It opened in temporary buildings in 1994 and has undergone multiple expansions, including doubling the casino size in 2002-2003, adding a conference center in 2004, and completing a $45 million hotel expansion in 2011. The resort began serving alcohol in 2006, a significant change for the previously 'dry' reservation.

Major_Events.Description: Wildhorse Resort & Casino opened in temporary buildings on November 5, 1994, initially managed by Capital Gaming International Inc.
The Confederated Tribes of the Umatilla Indian Reservation took over management of the casino.
After contentious discussion, the resort began serving alcoholic beverages on May 5, 2006, leading to the opening of the Wildhorse Sports Bar in 2007.
A $45 million project to expand the hotel by 202 rooms and add 24,000 square feet to the casino was completed in October 2011.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features a mix of modern and culturally inspired designs, including a 10-story hotel tower, a championship golf course, and the Tamástslikt Cultural Institute, which reflects the heritage of the Cayuse, Umatilla, and Walla Walla tribes.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The resort is culturally significant as it is owned and operated by the Confederated Tribes of the Umatilla Indian Reservation. It includes the Tamástslikt Cultural Institute, which showcases the history and culture of the Cayuse, Umatilla, and Walla Walla tribes. The resort has also spurred economic growth for the tribes, significantly increasing their operating budget and employment opportunities.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Entertainment and hospitality, including gaming, dining, lodging, and cultural education.
world knowledge.Details: The resort includes a casino with poker, roulette, blackjack, craps, Spanish 21, bingo, keno, and over 1200 slot machines; a five-screen cineplex; an 18-hole championship golf course; a 100-room hotel; an RV park; a children's entertainment center; a teepee camping village; and seven restaurants. The Tamástslikt Cultural Institute features exhibits on the tribes' history and culture. The resort draws approximately 750,000 visitors annually and has significantly boosted the tribal economy.

world knowledge.Name: Calder Casino & Race Course
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Calder Casino originated as Calder Race Course, envisioned by real estate developer Stephen A. Calder in the mid-1960s. The Florida Legislature approved summertime horse racing in 1965, and the track opened on May 6, 1971. Over the decades, it underwent ownership changes, renovations, and expansions. In 1999, Churchill Downs Incorporated purchased it for $86 million. The casino opened in 2010, and racing operations were leased to the Stronach Group in 2014.

Major_Events.Event: First day of racing at Calder Race Course
Major_Events.Description: Calder Race Course held its first day of racing on May 6, 1971.

Major_Events.Event: Introduction of the Summit of Speed
Major_Events.Description: The Summit of Speed attracted top sprinters and produced Breeders' Cup champions and Eclipse Award winners.
The grand opening of the Calder Casino was celebrated in January 2010.
South Florida's largest smoking-friendly open-air casino opened at Calder Casino on May 19, 2018.
A two-year-old horse named The Green Monkey sold for $16 million, setting a world record.
Eddie Castro set the North American record for the most wins in a day at one track, winning 9 races at Calder.
Antonio A. Gallardo set the record for the most stakes wins in a day and in a row, winning 4 consecutive stake races.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The casino features a large gaming floor with slot machines, electronic table games, and bingo. The Backyard Casino is an open-air, smoking-friendly area. The original grandstand was demolished in 2016.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Calder Casino and Race Course has played a significant role in Florida's horse racing history, hosting major events like the Summit of Speed and producing champion horses and jockeys. It also serves as a key entertainment venue in Miami Gardens.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Casino and former horse racing venue
world knowledge.Details: Calder Casino includes a player's club, VIP lounge, and dining options such as The Buffet, Lucky's Restaurant, and Center Bar. It is a non-smoking casino, except for The Backyard Casino. The track's main surface is a 12-inch sand and marl base with a 4.5-inch cushion, and the turf course is Tifton #419 Bermuda grass. Notable jockeys who started their careers at Calder include Javier Castellano, Edgar Prado, and José A. Santos.

world knowledge.Name: Casino Royale Hotel & Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened in 1964 as the Caravan Motor Hotel, the casino portion opened as Nob Hill in 1978 and later became Casino Royale in 1992. It joined the Best Western chain in 2012 and has undergone several renovations.

Major_Events.Description: Opened as a small Strip casino with low table game limits.
Remodeled and reopened by the Elardi family after Nob Hill's closure.
The hotel became part of the Best Western chain.
The Denny's was demolished and replaced with a two-story addition featuring a Walgreens and a new Denny's, along with a White Castle.
FAA approved plans to build a 699 ft tall building on the site.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Victorian/European-style architecture, designed to appear as various connected buildings.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Known for catering to low rollers and offering cheap amenities, it remains one of the few non-unionized casinos in Las Vegas.
world knowledge.Details: Features 19,000 sq ft of gaming space, including slot machines and table games. Popular for promotions like $3 beers and low-stakes gambling. Hosts notable restaurants such as Outback Steakhouse, Denny's, and White Castle.

world knowledge.Name: Batam Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Batam Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal is an international transport hub with shopping and restaurants in the center of Batam, Indonesia. Since its opening in 2006, it has been serving an average of 45,000 visitors coming from Singapore every month. The ferry terminal is part of an integrated development by Citra Buana Prakarsa that includes a hotel, shopping, entertainment, and apartments near the terminal.

Major_Events.Description: Sponsored by the Ministry of Tourism and Creative Economy of the Republic of Indonesia in collaboration with the Keppri Regional Government and Batam City Government. The Jazz Festival is held to increase foreign tourist visits.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The terminal serves as a significant international transport hub and has hosted cultural events like the Asean Jazz Festival to promote tourism.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: International transport hub with integrated shopping, dining, and accommodation facilities.
world knowledge.Details: There are 12 daily voyages between Harbour Front Singapore to Harbour Bay Batam, each lasting approximately 45 minutes. The terminal is served by Horizon Fast Ferry and Batam Fast, which commute between Singapore Harbourfront and Batam. Service also runs to nearby Rimau Island Karimun via MV Oceana Ferry or to Johor, Malaysia, Puteri Harbour Ferry Terminal, via Marine Hawk. Connected to the terminal is BayFront Mall, Harbour Bay Residences, a Marriott hotel, and Harbour Bay Seafood area.

world knowledge.Name: SkyCity Auckland
world knowledge.Historical_Background: SkyCity Auckland is an entertainment complex and casino located in the central business district of Auckland, New Zealand. It was the second casino in New Zealand and is the only casino in Auckland. The complex includes the Sky Tower, Sky City Theatre, bars, restaurants, and three hotels. The casino was last refurbished in 2006 and has approximately 1,600 gambling machines and 100 gambling tables.

Major_Events.Description: SkyCity Auckland purchased a 21m motor yacht for corporate entertainment.
SkyCity Auckland opened New Zealand's first purpose-built e-sports broadcasting studio.
SkyCity announced it would be slashing 700 jobs as a result of the economic effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.
SkyCity Auckland agreed to close for five days after failing to stop a problem gambler from spending over NZ$1 million in pokies.
The New Zealand government came to a deal with SkyCity to build a new convention center worth $402 million in exchange for gambling concessions.
A fire in the roof and upper part of the new convention center started while the building was still under construction, causing widespread disruption to Auckland's central business district.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The complex includes the Sky Tower, Sky City Theatre, bars, restaurants, and three hotels. The Sky Tower, convention center, and hotel were all built by Fletcher Construction and completed by 1997.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: SkyCity Auckland is a major entertainment and gambling hub in New Zealand. It provides almost 2000 jobs and has contributed significantly to the local economy. However, it has also been criticized for promoting problem gambling.
world knowledge.Details: SkyCity Auckland includes the Sky Tower, Sky City Theatre with a 700-seat auditorium, many bars and restaurants, and three hotels. The casino provides almost 2000 jobs and has returned NZD $670 million in dividends to mainly Australian shareholders. NZD $18.6 million was also paid to community organizations and trusts. 1.5% of the operating profit has to be paid out to charity according to law.

world knowledge.Name: Odawa Casino Resort
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Odawa Casino Resort opened on June 20, 2007, replacing Victories Casino, which had served as the tribe's casino until the new resort was opened. It is owned and operated by the Little Traverse Bay Bands of Odawa Indians.

Major_Events.Description: Bill Cosby performed two shows at the grand opening celebration.
The minimum gaming age at Odawa Casino Resort was approved to be lowered to 19 years old.
The buffet was closed during the COVID-19 pandemic with no plans to reopen as of October 2023.
On January 1, 2023, the gaming age returned to 21, and guests under 21 can only visit the restaurants and cannot step onto the gaming floor.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort was designed by Leo A. Daly Architects and constructed as a joint venture between Shingobee Builders and Clark Construction. The design features several LEED energy efficiency standards.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Odawa Casino Resort plays a major role in the Petoskey area in terms of income and influence. It employs roughly 1,000 people and was the 2nd largest employer in the area as of 2008.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Casino resort offering gaming, dining, entertainment, and lodging.

Entertainment_Venues.Name: The O Zone Nightclub
Features: DJs from radio stations 'Big Country' and '106 KHQ'
Large ceiling display for live video
Party pods with private plasma screens and fireplaces
Stand-up comedy, variety shows, cooking shows

Details.Transportation: Full shuttle transportation available to all resort guests
Details.Future_Plans: Possible additions may include a new hotel integrated into the Casino property, but no firm date has been set due to economic issues.

world knowledge.Name: WinStar World Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: WinStar World Casino and Resort is an American tribal casino and hotel owned and operated by the Chickasaw Nation. It opened as WinStar Casinos in 2004 and was expanded and renamed in 2009. It became the world's largest casino by gaming floor space. Major expansions in 2013 and 2014 further increased its size and facilities.

Major_Events.Event: Grand Opening of Original Hotel Tower
Major_Events.Description: The 395-room hotel tower held a grand opening celebration featuring performances by Kelly Clarkson and Lynyrd Skynyrd.
A 1000-room second hotel tower was added in two phases, along with a new casino, making it the largest casino in the United States.
The casino closed from March 16 to March 31, 2020, and remained closed throughout April 2020 due to the coronavirus pandemic. It reopened in May 2020 with restrictive guidelines.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The exterior features replicas of London's Parliament Building, Rome's Coliseum, and the Arc de Triomphe from Paris. The design was influenced by noted designer Larry E. Seitz, with special effects and sculptures by Dallas-based ValueWorks. The exterior was detailed by Lyndon Stromberg, known for his work on The Venetian and MGM Grand in Las Vegas.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: WinStar is culturally significant as the largest casino in the United States by gaming floor space and number of games. It is a major entertainment hub, attracting visitors from North Texas and Oklahoma, and hosts popular events at its Global Event Center.
world knowledge.Details: The casino features over 8,600 electronic games, a 55-table poker room, 100 total table games, and multiple high limit rooms. It includes three hotel towers with 1,399 rooms, a resort-style pool, spa, and various restaurants. The WinStar Golf Club offers two 18-hole championship golf courses. The FunTown RV park provides 200 spaces with shuttle service to the casino.

world knowledge.Name: Suncoast Hotel and Casino
world knowledge.Address: 9090 Alta Drive, Las Vegas, Nevada, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Suncoast Hotel and Casino was initially announced as the Sundance in 1998 but was renamed due to a copyright issue. Construction began in July 1999, and the property opened on September 12, 2000. Owned by Michael Gaughan's Coast Resorts, it was later acquired by Boyd Gaming in 2004. The hotel initially opened with 203 rooms, with an additional 167 rooms added in 2001 due to high occupancy rates. The resort has undergone several expansions and renovations, including the addition of a poker room in 2006 and various restaurant openings and updates over the years.

Major_Events.Description: Seven construction workers suffered minor injuries when a 32-foot concrete slab, part of the second floor, collapsed during construction.
The Suncoast opened on September 12, 2000, with a five-minute, $75,000 fireworks show. The opening attracted an estimated 5,000 people.
Due to high occupancy rates, the unfinished half of the hotel tower was completed, adding 167 rooms at a cost of $11 million.
The Suncoast opened a poker room in July 2006.
U.S. president Donald Trump attended a fundraiser for U.S. senator Dean Heller and spoke at the Nevada Republican Party's state convention at the Suncoast.
The 49-acre property was put up for sale for $87 million through an NNN lease, though the Suncoast itself was not included in the sale.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Suncoast features a Mediterranean theme with a 10-story hotel building. The casino includes gold and purple neon lighting, a large race and sportsbook, and a 600-seat bingo hall. The resort also features a moving walkway from the parking garage to the casino, a 64-lane bowling alley, and a multiplex movie theater.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Suncoast is significant as one of the first major resorts in Nevada to utilize coinless slot machines, pioneering this technology in the region. It has also been a popular destination for local Las Vegas residents, offering a variety of entertainment options including bowling, movies, and concerts.
world knowledge.Details: The Suncoast includes a 95,898-square-foot casino, 432 hotel rooms, a movie theater, bowling alley, and convention space. Notable restaurants include SC Prime Steakhouse and Bar, Brigg's Oyster Company, and William B's Steakhouse. The resort has undergone several renovations and expansions, including a $65 million expansion plan in 2002 that was later put on hold. The property was put up for sale in 2019, though the Suncoast itself was not included in the sale.

world knowledge.Name: Bad Oeynhausen
world knowledge.Location: District of Minden-Lübbecke, on the southern edge of the Wiehengebirge
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Bad Oeynhausen originated from the discovery of a thermal salt spring in 1845, leading to its development as a spa town. It was renamed 'Royal Bath Oeynhausen' in 1848 and received town charter in 1860. The town grew with spa activities, architectural developments, and post-war British occupation.

Major_Events.Description: Carl Baron of Oeynhausen discovered a thermal salt spring while drilling for salt deposits, leading to the town's development as a spa destination.
King Frederick William IV of Prussia renamed the town to 'Royal Bath Oeynhausen' after the discovery of the thermal spring.
The town's tank factory was bombed on 30 March 1945 during World War II.
Bad Oeynhausen hosted the Control Commission for Germany – British Element and served as the British Army of the Rhine headquarters.
Seven surrounding municipalities were merged with Bad Oeynhausen into one commune.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The town features a conglomeration of 19th-century architectural styles, including the Kurpark (spa garden) designed by Peter Joseph Lenné, the Kurhaus (spa hotel), and bourgeois mansions around the spa garden. The Jordansprudel, a carbonated thermal salt spring, is a notable landmark.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Bad Oeynhausen is culturally significant as a historic spa town with healing thermal springs, architectural diversity, and a role in post-war British occupation. It is also known for its health treatment facilities and the world's highest carbonated thermal salt spring.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Spa and health tourism, rehabilitation, and historical preservation.

Details.Climate: Oceanic Climate
Landmarks: Jordansprudel (world's highest carbonated thermal salt spring)
Health_Facilities: Heart and Diabetes Center North Rhine-Westphalia
Details.Transport: Connected by the Cologne-Minden railway line since 1847.
Details.Agriculture: A large percentage of the area is used for agriculture, typical for the Minden-Lübbecke district.

world knowledge.Name: Park MGM
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as Monte Carlo Resort and Casino on June 21, 1996, it was rebranded as Park MGM in 2018 after a major renovation. The resort was developed by Mirage Resorts and Circus Circus Enterprises, later acquired by MGM. It features a hotel-within-a-hotel concept, initially as Hotel32 and later as NoMad Las Vegas.

Major_Events.Description: A fire caused by welding on the rooftop forced evacuation and closure of the resort. Thirteen people were treated for smoke inhalation, and the resort suffered nearly $100 million in damages and lost revenue.
The resort underwent a two-year, $550 million renovation and was rebranded as Park MGM, removing the Monte Carlo theme and introducing new amenities like NoMad Las Vegas.
Park MGM became the only smoke-free casino resort on the Las Vegas Strip upon reopening after the COVID-19 pandemic closure.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Originally designed with Belle Époque architecture inspired by the Monte Carlo Casino in Monaco. The resort features a 32-story tower, a 76,982 sq ft casino, and multiple themed areas like the Street of Dreams. The rooftop includes hidden machinery behind a facade made of exterior insulation finishing system (EIFS).
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Park MGM represents the evolution of Las Vegas resorts from themed properties to modern, locally inspired entertainment hubs. It has hosted notable entertainers like Lance Burton and the Blue Man Group, and its Dolby Live theater features residencies by global stars like Lady Gaga and Aerosmith.
world knowledge.Details: Park MGM includes a 76,982 sq ft casino, 2,993 rooms (including NoMad Las Vegas), and multiple dining options like Bavette's Steakhouse and Eataly. The resort features the Dolby Live theater, which hosts major residencies, and has a non-smoking policy unique to the Strip. The property has appeared in films and TV shows, including 'Dodgeball' and 'The X-Files'.

world knowledge.Name: Parq Vancouver
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Parq Casino is a mixed-use development located adjacent to BC Place in Vancouver, British Columbia. It opened on September 29, 2017, replacing the former Edgewater Casino which was located across the street at the Plaza of Nations.

Major_Events.Description: The Parq casino opened on September 29, 2017, the same day the Edgewater Casino closed.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The development consists of three towers: JW Marriott North Tower (83 m), JW Marriott South Tower (57 m), and The Douglas (59 m). Designed by ACDF Architecture and Architecture49, with IBI Group Architects (Canada) Inc. as the Project Architect and Architect of Record.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Parq Vancouver is a significant mixed-use development in Vancouver, combining luxury hotels, a casino, restaurants, and event spaces, contributing to the city's tourism and entertainment industry.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Destination Resort, Hotel, Casino, Convention Center
world knowledge.Details: The two-floor casino at Parq Casino has 600 slot machines and 75 gaming tables. The development includes 517 rooms, 5 restaurants, 3 bars, and 1,069 parking stalls. It features 5,800 square metres (62,000 sq ft) of event space and a 2,800-square-metre (30,000 sq ft) open space on level 6.

world knowledge.Name: Colusa Casino Resort
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Cachil DeHe Band of Wintun Native Americans of the Colusa Native Americans Community of the Colusa Rancheria is a federally recognized tribe of Wintun Native Americans from central California. The tribe's reservation, the Colusa Rancheria, was founded in 1907.

Major_Events.Description: The Cachil Dehe Band of Wintun Indians, with 45 original members, ratified their constitution and by-laws on November 23, 1941.
In 1969 the tribe started to build a traditional roundhouse and refurbished it in 1993.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Traditional roundhouse and modern facilities including the Colusa Casino Resort.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The tribe is part of the Wintun Native Americans and has worked to preserve their traditional Patwin/Wintun language through publications and media. The community is a federally recognized tribe with a rich cultural heritage.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Serving as a reservation and cultural center for the Cachil DeHe Band of Wintun Native Americans, as well as operating the Colusa Casino Resort.
world knowledge.Details: The tribe owns and operates the Colusa Casino Resort, Table 45 (casual dining), 37 Seventy (fine dining), and Jack's Place (bar), all located inside Colusa Casino Resort. The ranchería is served by the Colusa Unified School District. The population is approximately 77.

world knowledge.Name: Harrah's Atlantic City
world knowledge.Address: 777 Harrah's Boulevard, Atlantic City, New Jersey
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Harrah's Resort Atlantic City is a casino hotel in the marina district of Atlantic City, New Jersey, owned by Vici Properties and operated by Caesars Entertainment. It was the first casino in the marina district and the fifth to open in Atlantic City after the legalization of gambling.
