Originally conceived as the 'Holiday Inn Marina Casino', it was rebranded to Harrah's Marina Hotel Casino after Holiday Inns purchased Harrah's Corporation. The resort has undergone several expansions and renovations over the years, including the addition of multiple hotel towers and gaming spaces.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of Harrah's Marina Hotel Casino
Major_Events.Description: Harrah's opened on November 22, 1980, with a 506-room hotel tower, becoming the top-grossing casino in the city.
Harrah's opened the all-suite Atrium Tower due to the complex's popularity and the opening of Trump's Castle across the road.
The Waterfront Tower opened, along with a new pool and spa, to better compete with the nearby Borgata.
Eldorado Resorts acquired Caesars Entertainment, taking over operations of the property. Vici Properties bought the real estate of Harrah's Atlantic City for $599 million.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Harrah's features multiple towers, including the 46-story Waterfront Tower, which is Atlantic City's second tallest building. The resort includes a variety of architectural styles due to multiple expansions and renovations. The Waterfront Tower features an exterior LED display surface, believed to be the largest in the world.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Harrah's is one of the largest hotels in New Jersey and a major entertainment destination in Atlantic City. It has hosted numerous high-profile events, including boxing matches and concerts by famous artists. The resort's pool area, 'The Pool After Dark,' is a popular nightlife destination.
world knowledge.Details: Harrah's features 177,000 sq ft of gaming space with 5,567 slot and video poker machines and 139 table games. It includes a 40-table poker room and a sportsbook. The resort offers a variety of dining options, including a restaurant by Gordon Ramsay, and a spa. Harrah's also provides transportation services, including the Caesars Rewards Shuttle and access via the Atlantic City Jitney Association.

world knowledge.Name: Harrah's Gulf Coast
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as Grand Casino Biloxi in 1994, it was destroyed by Hurricane Katrina in 2005. Rebuilt and reopened in 2006 under Harrah's ownership, later managed by Caesars Entertainment. Ownership transferred to Vici Properties in 2017.

Major_Events.Description: Destroyed the original casino barge and damaged the property, leading to demolition and reconstruction.
First phase reopened with a 495-room hotel and land-based casino after Katrina.
Property ownership transferred to Vici Properties, leased back to Caesars Entertainment.
Buffets were permanently removed and replaced with a food court due to COVID-19 policies.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Land-based casino resort with hotels, gaming space, and convention facilities. Originally a barge-based casino before post-Katrina reconstruction.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: A major gaming and entertainment destination on the Gulf Coast, symbolizing post-Katrina recovery and economic resilience.

image_name: Sam's Town Hotel and Gambling Hall, Tunica

world knowledge.Name: Sam's Town Hotel and Gambling Hall, Tunica
world knowledge.Address: 1477 Casino Strip Resorts Boulevard, Robinsonville, Mississippi 38664
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Sam's Town Hotel and Gambling Hall was opened on May 25, 1994, by Boyd Gaming as the third casino branded as Sam's Town and the first casino opened by Boyd outside of Nevada. It was built to replicate a Western town and initially featured a 200-room hotel. In 2002, Boyd expanded the property by acquiring an adjacent hotel and theater, adding an additional hotel tower and parking garage.

Major_Events.Event: Sam's Town 250 NASCAR Busch Series race
Major_Events.Description: Boyd sponsored the Sam's Town 250, a NASCAR Busch Series race at nearby Memphis International Raceway.
The hotel and casino were closed from March until May due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort resembles its Nevada sibling, except for the atrium. It is designed to replicate a Western town and includes a riverboat casino, which is situated on barges floating in a pool of water linked to the nearby Mississippi River.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Sam's Town Hotel and Gambling Hall is significant as one of the early riverboat casinos in Mississippi and as the first Boyd Gaming property outside of Nevada. It has played a role in local entertainment and tourism, including hosting NASCAR events.
world knowledge.Details: The facility includes a 1,600-seat showroom, a 1,070-room hotel, and an RV park. As of November 2020, Sam's Town has over 700 hotel rooms in Tunica. The total gaming space is 96,000 sq ft (8,900 m2).

world knowledge.Name: El Cortez (Las Vegas)
world knowledge.Address: 600 East Fremont Street, Las Vegas, Nevada 89101
world knowledge.Historical_Background: El Cortez is one of the oldest casino-hotel properties in Las Vegas, opened on November 7, 1941. It was built by Marion Hicks and J.C. Grayson for $245,000 and later purchased by organized crime figures including Bugsy Siegel, Meyer Lansky, Gus Greenbaum, and Moe Sedway in 1945. The property has undergone several ownership changes and renovations, maintaining its historic significance.

Major_Events.Description: El Cortez opened as downtown Las Vegas' first major resort.
Bugsy Siegel, Meyer Lansky, Gus Greenbaum, and Moe Sedway bought the property for $600,000.

Major_Events.Event: Added to National Register of Historic Places
Major_Events.Description: The structure was placed on the National Register of Historic Places.
El Cortez was closed by police for several hours following a shooting.
El Cortez underwent a $20 million renovation, adding a high-limit slot room, two new bars, a new restaurant, and a Starbucks coffee shop.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Primarily Spanish Colonial Revival in style, reflecting a 1952 remodel. The property retains its original signage and ranch-themed architecture.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: El Cortez is one of the oldest continuously operating casinos in Las Vegas and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places. It is a prominent example of early Las Vegas gaming and architecture.
world knowledge.Details: El Cortez is known as a 'break-in house' for new table-game dealers. It includes a restaurant, Siegel's 1941, featuring memorabilia from Bugsy Siegel. The property became a 21-and-over establishment in 2022. It has a novelty following online for allowing live table play streaming.

world knowledge.Name: Ormsby House
world knowledge.Address: 600 South Carson Street, Carson City, Nevada, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Ormsby House is a closed hotel and casino in Carson City, Nevada. Originally opened in 1972, it has undergone multiple ownership changes, renovations, and closures. The original Ormsby House was built in 1860 by Major William Ormsby but was demolished in the early 1900s. The current structure was built in 1972 by former Nevada Governor Paul Laxalt.

Major_Events.Description: The original Ormsby House was built by Major William Ormsby at the corner of 2nd and Carson Streets.
The original hotel was purchased by Dominique Laxalt and later demolished.
A new Ormsby House was built by former Nevada Governor Paul Laxalt at the corner of 5th and Carson Streets.
The hotel was forced into bankruptcy protection due to competition from Indian casinos in California.
The property was foreclosed and shut down.
The hotel was reopened by Barry Silverton.
The Ormsby House went through bankruptcy and foreclosure again.
The property was sold for $3.75 million to Carson City businessmen Al Fiegehen and Don Lehr.
The hotel was closed for extensive renovations, which have been delayed multiple times.
The building permit for renovations expired, and plans shifted to converting the building into housing and retail space.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed by David Jacobson Associates, the building features an Old West theme. The planned renovations include a hotel, large casino, four bars, wedding chapel, coffeehouse, fine dining restaurant, buffet, nightclub, and entertainment center.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Ormsby House is a notable landmark in Carson City, reflecting the city's historical and economic ties to the gaming and hospitality industry. Its history spans over a century, with connections to prominent figures like Major William Ormsby and former Nevada Governor Paul Laxalt.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Originally a hotel and casino, the property is now planned for mixed-use development including housing and retail.
world knowledge.Details: As of January 2023, the Ormsby House is still closed and up for sale. The property has faced numerous challenges, including construction delays, permit problems, and management changes. A small slots and video poker casino, the Winchester Club, operated intermittently in the hotel's parking structure to maintain the Nevada state gaming license.

world knowledge.Name: Isle of Capri Boonville
world knowledge.Address: 100 Isle of Capri Blvd, Boonville, Missouri
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Isle of Capri Casino and Hotel Boonville is a stationary boat hotel and casino on the Missouri River in Boonville, Missouri. It opened on December 6, 2001, and was originally operated by Isle of Capri Casinos, Inc. In 2017, Isle of Capri Casinos was acquired by Eldorado Resorts (later named Caesars Entertainment).

Major_Events.Description: Isle of Capri Casinos was acquired by Eldorado Resorts (later named Caesars Entertainment).
The remodel included new carpet, additional TVs in the bar and table games area, a redesigned casino bar, and a redesigned cashier's cage.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Riverboat casino and hotel with 140 rooms, including 26 junior suites, and 12,000 square feet of meeting and banquet space.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Isle of Capri Boonville is a notable entertainment and gaming destination in Missouri, hosting events, concerts, and conventions.
world knowledge.Details: The casino features over 800 gaming machines and 16 table games, including blackjack, craps, double-deck blackjack, 21+3 Extreme, Criss-Cross Poker, Cajun Stud, High Card Flush, and EZ-Baccarat. It also has two restaurants and hosts various events such as weddings, concerts, and trade shows.

world knowledge.Name: Hollywood Gaming at Dayton Raceway
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally established in 1959 as Raceway Park in Toledo, Ohio, hosting car racing and thoroughbred racing. In 2011, Governor John Kasich agreed to allow video lottery terminals at Ohio's seven racetracks. To avoid having Raceway Park compete with its own Hollywood Casino Toledo, Penn National sought and obtained state approval to move Raceway Park to Dayton. The racetrack move was completed in the spring of 2014. The racino opened on August 28, 2014 with 1,000 video lottery terminals.

Major_Events.Description: Took place every year until ending recently. The race once successfully predicted the outcome of the rival Ohio State-Michigan football game with 75% accuracy.
Penn National sought and obtained state approval to move Raceway Park to Dayton to avoid competition with Hollywood Casino Toledo.
The racino opened on August 28, 2014 with 1,000 video lottery terminals.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Known for weekend live harness racing including Ohio Sire Stakes and Buckeye-Wolverine Pace. The Buckeye-Wolverine Pace was a notable event that once predicted the outcome of the Ohio State-Michigan football game with 75% accuracy.
world knowledge.Details: Owned by Gaming and Leisure Properties and operated by Penn Entertainment. Features a 5/8 mile oval track for Standardbred racing. Notable race: Dayton Pacing Derby.

world knowledge.Name: Dunes (hotel and casino)
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Dunes was a hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip, opening in 1955 as the tenth resort on the Strip. It struggled initially but thrived under Major Riddle's management from 1956. Known for its Arabian theme, it introduced Las Vegas' first topless show and featured notable amenities like the Emerald Green golf course. Financial troubles in the 1980s led to its sale and eventual closure in 1993, with the site redeveloped into the Bellagio.

Major_Events.Description: The Dunes opened as the tenth resort on the Las Vegas Strip, featuring an Arabian theme and initially struggling financially.

Major_Events.Event: First topless show in Las Vegas
Major_Events.Description: The Dunes debuted 'Minsky Goes to Paris,' the first topless show in Las Vegas, inspiring other resorts to follow suit.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of the Emerald Green golf course
Major_Events.Description: The Dunes opened the Emerald Green golf course, the longest in Nevada at 7,240 yards.
The original North Tower was imploded in a highly publicized event to make way for the Bellagio.
The Dunes closed permanently, ending its 38-year run on the Las Vegas Strip.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Dunes featured an Arabian theme with designs by John Replogle and Robert Dorr Jr. The resort included a 21-story North Tower and a 17-story South Tower, as well as the world's tallest free-standing sign at 181 feet. Notable restaurants like Sultan's Table and Dome of the Sea had unique designs, including an underwater-themed interior for the latter.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Dunes was culturally significant for introducing Las Vegas' first topless show and for its connections to Mafia figures and entertainment history. Its implosion marked the end of an era and the beginning of modern megaresorts on the Strip.

Details.Permanent shows: Minsky's Follies, Vive Les Girls, Casino de Paris
Details.Notable restaurants: Sultan's Table, Dome of the Sea, Top O' the Strip
Details.Architects: John Replogle and Robert Dorr Jr. (1955), Milton Schwartz (1964–65 additions), Maxwell Starkman (1979 hotel addition)

world knowledge.Name: Paiute Palace Casino
world knowledge.Address: Bishop Community of the Bishop Colony, Bishop, California
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Bishop Paiute Tribe is a federally recognized tribe of Mono and Timbisha Indians of the Owens Valley. The reservation was established in 1912. In 1932, President Hoover downsized the reservation from 67,000 acres to roughly 900 acres to enable the city of Los Angeles to pipe water from Bishop to Los Angeles County without negotiating a right-of-way with the Paiute.

Major_Events.Description: President Hoover downsized the reservation from 67,000 acres to roughly 900 acres to enable the city of Los Angeles to pipe water from Bishop to Los Angeles County without negotiating a right-of-way with the Paiute.
The tribe built the Paiute Palace Casino (renamed Wanaaha Casino in 2020) for economic development.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Bishop Paiute Tribe is culturally significant as a federally recognized tribe with a rich heritage, including traditional languages (Timbisha and Mono), a cultural center, and active repatriation programs. The tribe is the fifth largest Native American tribe in California.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Sovereign tribal community with governance, cultural preservation, and economic development initiatives.

Details.Reservation_Population: Approximately 1,441 tribal members live on the reservation.
Details.Governance: Governed by a democratically elected five-member tribal council, which changes every 2 years. The council has powers to appoint authorities, make ordinances, and distribute land.
Details.Languages: Traditionally spoke Timbisha (Central Numic) and Mono (Western Numic) languages.

Facilities.Cultural_Center: Owens Valley Paiute Shoshone Cultural Center

Details.Economic_Initiatives: Robust rooftop solar installation program serving hundreds of homes.
Details.Education_Districts: Served by the Bishop Union Elementary School District and Bishop Joint Union High School District.

image_name: Sam's Town Hotel and Gambling Hall, Shreveport

world knowledge.Name: Sam's Town Hotel and Gambling Hall, Shreveport
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally known as Harrah's Shreveport, the hotel was purchased in 2004 by Boyd Gaming from Harrah's Entertainment. It was rebranded under Boyd's Sam's Town brand on May 20, 2004, becoming the fifth casino under that name.

Major_Events.Event: Purchase and rebranding by Boyd Gaming
Major_Events.Description: Boyd Gaming acquired the property from Harrah's Entertainment and rebranded it as Sam's Town Shreveport.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: 23-story hotel with an Old West theme.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: As a major casino and hotel in Shreveport, it contributes to the local economy and entertainment industry.

Details.Notable restaurants: International Buffet, Java's Deli, Smokey Joe's Cafe, William B's Steakhouse

world knowledge.Name: Eagle Mountain Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Eagle Mountain Casino is an Indian tribal casino operated by the Tule River Indian Tribe. It originally opened on June 1, 1996, on the Tule River Reservation. Due to water shortages and accessibility issues, the tribe received approval in 2020 to relocate the casino to a 40-acre site near Porterville Municipal Airport. The new facility, designed to reflect Tule River heritage, opened in 2023.

Major_Events.Description: The casino originally opened on the Tule River Reservation.
The Bureau of Indian Affairs approved the relocation of the casino to a site near Porterville.
Construction began on the new casino facility.
The new casino had a soft opening on April 17, 2023, followed by a full opening on May 9, 2023.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The new casino's architecture reflects Tule River heritage, incorporating cultural symbols like giant sequoias and golden eagles. It includes a 100,000-square-foot gaming floor, 250 hotel rooms, 29,000 square feet of convention space, restaurants, and a sports bar.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is culturally significant as it is operated by the Tule River Indian Tribe and reflects their heritage. It also provides economic self-sufficiency for the tribe and resources for tribal members.
world knowledge.Details: The new casino features 1,750 slot machines and 20 table games, serves alcohol on the floor, and has a minimum gambling age of 21. The original casino building was repurposed for tribal offices, schools, and food service for tribal residents. The relocation addressed water shortages and improved accessibility.

world knowledge.Name: Barton's Club 93
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Barton's Club 93 was founded in 1957 as a motel next to Cactus Pete's. The operation was expanded in the 1970s to a property directly across the street. The name 'Club 93' is a reference to U.S. Route 93, the main road in Jackpot where the property is located.

Major_Events.Description: The operation was expanded to a property directly across the street from its original location.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Barton's Club 93 is the largest privately held property in Jackpot and one of the main competitors of the Pinnacle Entertainment-owned Cactus Pete's and Horseshu Casino.
world knowledge.Details: The casino features more than three hundred slot machines. It is owned by Club 93, Inc. and has 102 rooms.

world knowledge.Name: Delta Downs
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Delta Downs Racetrack, Casino and Hotel opened in September 1973 under the direction of Lee Berwick, primarily for Quarter Horse racing. It was later purchased by Boyd Gaming, which made significant capital improvements. The facility was damaged by Hurricane Rita in 2005 but reopened after repairs. The track has hosted both Quarter Horse and Thoroughbred races and has improved in quality due to revenue from its casino.

Major_Events.Description: The casino, hotel, and track were badly damaged by Hurricane Rita. The casino and hotel partially reopened two months later, while the track was closed for about six months.

Jockey Sylvester Carmouche hid his horse in thick fog during a race, resulting in a fraudulent win. He was convicted of felony theft by fraud and banned from state tracks for ten years (later reduced to eight).

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The track is a 6-furlong oval with a 550-yard Quarter-Horse chute, also functioning as a 1.0625-mile Thoroughbred chute, and a 0.625-mile Thoroughbred chute. The surface is a mixture of sand (from the Sabine River) and clay, with a limestone base. The facility includes stabling for 1,200 horses and features horse pastures visible from the entrance.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Delta Downs is a significant venue for Quarter Horse and Thoroughbred racing in Louisiana. It has produced stakes-quality horses and hosts notable races like the Delta Jackpot Stakes and the Lee Burwick Futurity. The facility also contributes to the local economy through its casino and hotel.

Notable_Races: Restricted Grade I Lee Burwick Futurity

image_name: Hollywood Gaming at Mahoning Valley Race Course

world knowledge.Name: Hollywood Gaming at Mahoning Valley Race Course
world knowledge.Address: 655 North Canfield Niles Road, Youngstown, Ohio
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Hollywood Gaming at Mahoning Valley Race Course is a thoroughbred racino that opened on September 17, 2014. It replaced Beulah Park Racetrack in Columbus, Ohio. The facility features a one-mile dirt course and a gaming area with nearly 1,000 video lottery terminals. It is owned by Gaming and Leisure Properties and operated by Penn Entertainment.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of Mahoning Valley Race Course
Major_Events.Description: The racecourse officially opened on September 17, 2014, with racing operations beginning on November 24, 2014.

Major_Events.Event: Introduction of Steel Valley Sprint Stakes
Major_Events.Description: The $200,000 Steel Valley Sprint Stakes, a six-furlong dash for 3-year-old horses, was introduced as the track's signature race. The purse was later increased to $250,000.
Mahoning Valley Racecourse hosted the Best of Ohio Day, featuring four Ohio-bred stakes races.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The facility includes a one-mile oval racetrack, 80 feet wide, banked at 3% in the stretches and 6% in the turns. It features a grandstand, a gaming area, two main wagering areas, and a backstretch with 13 barns housing up to 988 horses. There is also a receiving barn with 54 stalls and dormitories for employees.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The racino serves as a key entertainment and gambling venue in Ohio, contributing to the local economy and the thoroughbred racing industry. It competes with nearby racetracks like Thistledown Racino and Mountaineer Racetrack.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Thoroughbred horse racing and gaming (video lottery terminals).
world knowledge.Details: The track operates live racing from late October to late April, with races held on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays (post time 12:45 P.M. EST), and Saturdays (post time 12:15 P.M. EST). The 2021 racing schedule included 17 stakes races, with purses for maiden special weights and allowance races reaching up to $29,000. The facility also features simulcast wagering and dormitories for horsemen.

world knowledge.Name: Hampton Beach Casino Ballroom
world knowledge.Address: 169 Ocean Boulevard, Hampton Beach, New Hampshire
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Hampton Beach Casino Ballroom is a seasonal live music and comedy venue located on the boardwalk of Hampton Beach, New Hampshire. It was opened on July 4, 1899, by Wallace D. Lovell to boost tourism. In 1927, the ballroom was added to accommodate larger audiences, becoming a major entertainment hub. Over the years, it underwent several renovations and name changes, including Club Casino (1976-92), and has hosted numerous notable performers.

Major_Events.Description: An additional 4,000 fans showed up to an already sold-out Jethro Tull concert, leading to a riot. Police and the National Guard were called in, resulting in the town banning rock concerts for years.

Major_Events.Event: Bob Weir and RatDog concert after Jerry Garcia's death
Major_Events.Description: On the day Jerry Garcia died, Bob Weir and his band RatDog performed at the Casino. Fans and media held a candlelight vigil in the parking lot.

Major_Events.Event: Micky Ward vs. Emanuel Augustus fight
Major_Events.Description: Micky Ward fought Emanuel Augustus at the Casino Ballroom, in a match later named the 2001 Fight of the Year.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The venue features a large dance floor and has undergone several renovations to restore its original features. The facade was redone in the 1990s.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Casino Ballroom is a historic entertainment venue that has hosted generations of performers, from Bing Crosby and Duke Ellington to modern acts. It is a key cultural landmark in Hampton Beach.
world knowledge.Details: The venue is open seasonally from April to November and schedules upwards of 70 shows per season. It was ranked #23 in Pollstar's Top 100 Worldwide Club Venues in 2010. It is the only venue to have hosted three generations of the Nelson family.

world knowledge.Name: Kah-Nee-Ta
world knowledge.Address: Warm Springs Indian Reservation, Oregon, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Kah-Nee-Ta Resort & Spa was initially started by a non-Indigenous doctor who owned land around the hot springs of the Warm Springs River. In 1961, the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs purchased the land back and began rebuilding the spa. The resort underwent several expansions and changes, including the addition of a casino, convention center, and golf course. It closed in 2018 but reopened in 2024.

Major_Events.Description: The great flood of 1964 damaged the spa and the bridge accessing it.
The Tribes began construction of the Kah-Nee-Ta Lodge using funds from low-interest loans from the Economic Development Administration (EDA).

Major_Events.Event: Expansion to include casino and convention center
Major_Events.Description: The Tribes expanded operations to include a casino and improved convention center.
The resort and casino were combined to form Kah-Nee-Ta High Desert Resort & Casino, which also included a golf course.
The resort's casino closed in December 2011 in preparation for relocating the business to a new property beside U.S. Route 26.
The resort closed on 5 September 2018, laying off all its employees.
The resort reopened in July 2024 after the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs approved spending $4.58 million to reopen portions of the resort.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The lodge was designed by Zimmer Gunsul Frasca Architects and stands as an example of seventies architecture, with strong North America indigenous and Scandinavian influences. The gigantic fireplace in the lobby represents raw concrete, North America Indigenous symbols, and Artichoke lamps by Poul Henningsen for Louis Poulsen.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Kah-Nee-Ta is culturally significant as it is located on the Warm Springs Indian Reservation and represents the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs' efforts to develop and maintain a resort and spa that incorporates indigenous influences.
world knowledge.Details: The resort includes amenities such as soaking pools, teepees, RV sites, and a 30-room hotel. The Lodge and golf course are not scheduled to be reopened as part of the 2024 reopening.

world knowledge.Name: Planet Hollywood Las Vegas
world knowledge.Physical_Area: 64,470 sq ft (5,989 m²) casino, 2,494 hotel rooms, 475,000 sq ft (44,100 m²) mall
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally the site of the Tallyho Hotel (1962), later became the Aladdin (1966). The Aladdin was demolished in 1998 and rebuilt, reopening in 2000. Financial struggles led to ownership changes, and it was rebranded as Planet Hollywood in 2007. Caesars Entertainment took ownership in 2010.

Major_Events.Description: Milton Prell reopened the property as the Aladdin with an Arabian Nights theme, featuring a casino, dining venues, and a showroom.
Elvis Presley and Priscilla Beaulieu married at the Aladdin.
The original Aladdin was imploded, and a new version was built, opening in 2000.
The resort was renovated and rebranded as Planet Hollywood, featuring a Hollywood theme.
Caesars Entertainment took full ownership of the resort.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Originally Arabian-themed, later modernized with Hollywood-inspired design, including LED screens and Times Square-inspired facade. Features a 39-story hotel tower and a 7,000-seat entertainment venue.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: A prominent casino and entertainment resort on the Las Vegas Strip, known for hosting celebrity events, movie premieres, and high-profile performances. It reflects the evolution of Las Vegas from themed casinos to modern entertainment complexes.
world knowledge.Details: Includes Miracle Mile Shops, PH Live theater, and notable restaurants like Koi and Gordon Ramsay Burger. Hosted residencies by Britney Spears and other artists. Featured in films such as '21', 'What Happens in Vegas', and 'Knocked Up'.

world knowledge.Name: Casino Miami Jai-Alai
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally known as Miami Jai-Alai Fronton, it was primarily used for Jai alai matches and boxing events. After a bankruptcy, an affiliate of ABC Funding acquired it in 2014. Phil Ruffin bought Casino Miami on December 3, 2018.

Major_Events.Description: The last Jai alai match held at the venue took place in January 2021.
The arena hosted 89 boxing events, including many involving famous former world champion boxers.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: A historic venue for Jai alai and boxing, now a prominent casino and concert venue in Miami.
world knowledge.Details: The venue has hosted numerous concerts by notable performers and was a key location for Jai alai and boxing events in the past.

world knowledge.Name: St Petrus House
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Built in 1927 by coffee merchant Ludwig Roselius as part of the development of Böttcherstraße, St Petrus House features North-German Gothic architecture. It was initially known as Haus HAG and later renamed. The building served as a casino for 30 years before being refurbished by the Atlantic Grand Hotel in 2011.

Major_Events.Description: Built by Ludwig Roselius as part of Böttcherstraße development, designed by architects Eduard Scotland and Alfred Runge in North German Gothic style.
The Bremen casino, housed in St Petrus House for 30 years, moved to the Schlachte.
Substantial refurbishment combining modernization with historical preservation, repurposing rooms for events and dining.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: North-German Gothic architecture with features like arcades, dormers, stepped gables, and a projecting arched entrance. Includes decorative elements such as the arms of Bremen, a statue of Petrus, and Paracelsus Head.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: A listed building since 1973, St Petrus House is a historic part of Bremen's architectural heritage, reflecting the city's commercial and cultural history through its design and usage.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Originally a mixed-use building with shops, studios, and apartments; later a casino and event venue; currently part of the Atlantic Grand Hotel with dining and event spaces.
world knowledge.Details: The building includes the Weinkontor St. Petrus restaurant (since 1999) and features rooms like the Golden Hall and Scotland Hall, used for events. External decorations include works by Engelhard Tölken and Bernhard Hoetger.

world knowledge.Name: Wynn Las Vegas
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Wynn Las Vegas is a luxury resort and casino located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It was built on the former site of the Desert Inn resort, which opened in 1950. Casino developer Steve Wynn purchased and closed the Desert Inn in 2000, with plans to build a new resort. Construction began on October 31, 2002, and the resort opened on April 28, 2005, at a cost of $2.7 billion, making it the most expensive resort ever built at the time.

Major_Events.Description: The resort opened on April 28, 2005, with 2,716 rooms and a 111,000 sq ft casino. It was the first new resort to open on the Strip since the Aladdin in 2000.
A sister property, Encore Las Vegas, was opened by Wynn Resorts in December 2008, adding a second hotel tower and additional gaming space.

The Wynn properties were among the first Las Vegas resorts to close in March 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic. They reopened three months later with all amenities allowed under state health guidelines.
The show 'Awakening' opened in November 2022, replacing the previous show 'Le Rêve'. It features music, choreography, and large-scale puppetry in a renovated theater.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Wynn Las Vegas features a 45-story hotel tower with a curved floor plan and a swooped crown. The exterior consists of bronze reflective glass with white lines that light up at night. The resort does not follow a specific theme but emphasizes natural light, an indoor garden atrium, and the use of red, a lucky color among Asian gamblers. The design includes an artificial mountain obscuring attractions from outside pedestrians, a 3-acre lake, and a 135-foot-tall roadside sign with an LED screen.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Wynn Las Vegas is culturally significant as a landmark of luxury and innovation in the Las Vegas Strip. It has received numerous accolades, including the AAA Five Diamond Award and the Forbes Travel Guide Five Star award. The resort has also been featured in films and is one of the most photographed hotels in the world.

Details.Gaming_Space: 111,000 sq ft (10,300 m²) upon opening, now 188,786 sq ft (17,538.8 m²) including Encore

world knowledge.Name: Lakeside Inn (Stateline)
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as Tahoe Sky Harbor in 1946, later renamed Fabulous Eddie's Stardust Club (1957–1969), Caesars Inn (1969–1972), Harvey's Inn (1972–1985), and finally Lakeside Inn (1985–2020). The property was expanded and renovated multiple times under different owners. It closed permanently in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic and was later purchased for demolition to build a healthcare facility.

Major_Events.Description: A fire broke out during welding in the remodeled casino, heavily damaging the new casino area and motel lobby, and causing water damage to the restaurant area.
Harvey A. Gross, owner of Harvey's Resort Hotel, purchased Caesars Inn and expanded the property.
Following the death of Harvey A. Gross, the property was sold and reopened as Lakeside Inn.
Closed due to the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.
The shuttered casino was purchased for $13 million with plans to demolish it and build a healthcare facility.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Rustic Lodge theme with a casino, hotel, restaurants, and bars.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: A historic hotel and casino in Stateline, Nevada, that underwent multiple ownership changes and renovations, reflecting the evolution of the Lake Tahoe gaming and hospitality industry.

world knowledge.Name: Sands Atlantic City
world knowledge.Address: 119 South Indiana Avenue, Atlantic City, New Jersey
world knowledge.Physical_Area: 628,000 square feet (58,300 m²) on 4.5 acres (1.8 ha)
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as the Brighton Hotel & Casino in 1980, it was the fourth casino in Atlantic City following the legalization of gambling in 1977. It was later renamed the Sands Atlantic City after being acquired by Inns of the Americas. The property struggled financially over the years, underwent multiple ownership changes, and eventually closed in 2006. It was demolished in 2007 to make way for a new development that was later canceled.

Major_Events.Description: The Brighton Hotel & Casino opened on August 13, 1980, as the first casino in Atlantic City built from the ground up.
After financial struggles, the property was renamed Sands Atlantic City under new ownership.
The Sands filed for bankruptcy protection, leading to restructuring under Carl Icahn's ownership.

Major_Events.Event: Closure and Sale to Pinnacle Entertainment
Major_Events.Description: The casino closed on November 11, 2006, and was sold to Pinnacle Entertainment, which planned to demolish and rebuild it.
The Sands was imploded on October 18, 2007, marking the first-ever casino-hotel implosion on the East Coast.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The property consisted of a 21-story hotel tower with 532 rooms and a 5-story podium housing a 57,045 sq ft casino, restaurants, and shops. It featured a desert theme and later incorporated film-themed decor during an attempted rebranding.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Sands was a notable casino in Atlantic City, hosting top entertainers like Frank Sinatra and Whitney Houston. It represented the early era of legalized gambling in the city and underwent multiple transformations reflecting the challenges of the casino industry.
world knowledge.Details: The Sands was the last casino in North America to bear the Sands name until the Sands Casino Resort Bethlehem opened in 2009. It was adjacent to The Claridge Hotel and later took over the Madison Hotel for expansion. The property struggled with financial issues and competition from newer casinos, leading to its eventual closure and demolition.

world knowledge.Name: Crown Melbourne
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Crown Melbourne is an integrated resort consisting of a casino and hotel located on the south bank of the Yarra River, in Melbourne, Australia. It was initially opened in 1994 on the north bank of the Yarra River as a temporary setup while construction of the proper complex occurred. The permanent location opened on 8 May 1997 on the southern bank of the Yarra River. It was founded, owned, and run by Lloyd Williams until taken over by Publishing & Broadcasting Limited in 1999.

Major_Events.Description: Crown Melbourne opened on 30 June 1994 at the World Trade Centre on the northern bank of the Yarra River as a temporary setup.
Crown's permanent location opened on 8 May 1997 on the southern bank of the Yarra River.
Actress Rachel Griffiths ran through the casino topless on its opening night to protest the project.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed by a team of architects and interior designers including Bates Smart, Perrott Lyon Mathieson, and Daryl Jackson. The complex features water features both inside and outside, and along the Yarra River, there are eight towers that shoot spheres of fire at night.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Crown Melbourne is one of the central features of the Southbank precinct of the Melbourne central business district. It is the largest casino complex in the Southern Hemisphere and one of the largest in the world. It hosts premier functions such as the annual Logie Awards, Brownlow Medal, and other significant events.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Integrated resort consisting of a casino and hotel.
world knowledge.Details: Crown Melbourne has a licence for 540 table games (100 poker tables) and 2,500 poker machines. It includes several nightclubs, restaurants, an electronic games arcade, laser tag game, bowling alley, and luxury brands. The complex hosts three hotels: Crown Towers, Crown Promenade, and Crown Metropol. The Palladium at Crown is a ballroom with a seating capacity of 1500, hosting premier functions. Children under 18 are permitted into the entertainment and shopping sections but not into gaming or alcohol-serving areas.

world knowledge.Name: Delaware Park Racetrack
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Designed and built by William duPont, Jr. and Donald P. Ross, with Phillip T. Harris as the architectural engineer. Opened on June 26, 1937, it is the only thoroughbred horse racing track in Delaware. The facility has evolved to include a casino and golf course.

Major_Events.Description: The facility opened as a Thoroughbred horse racing track.
The casino at Delaware Park houses close to 2,500 slot machines and offers table games, contributing to increased race purses.
Betting on NFL games was legalized, later expanded in 2018 to include single-game and parlay betting on various sports.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed by William duPont, Jr., a designer of twenty-three racing courses, with Phillip T. Harris as the architectural engineer. The facility includes a racetrack, casino, and golf course.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Delaware Park is significant as the only thoroughbred horse racing track in Delaware and has hosted notable horses like Afleet Alex and Barbaro. It also plays a role in the local economy through its casino and sports betting facilities.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Thoroughbred horse racing, casino gaming, and golfing
world knowledge.Details: Delaware Park offers simulcasts of races from other tracks, live table games, and an 18-hole golf course called White Clay Creek Country Club. The track hosts graded stakes races and has a strong equestrian community presence.

world knowledge.Name: Hollywood Casino Lawrenceburg
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally named Argosy Casino and operated by Argosy Gaming Company, it was acquired by Penn National Gaming (now Penn Entertainment) in 2004. In June 2009, it was rebranded as Hollywood Casino and expanded with a larger riverboat.

Major_Events.Description: Argosy Gaming Company was acquired by Penn National Gaming (now Penn Entertainment).
The casino was rebranded as Hollywood Casino and unveiled a larger riverboat with increased capacity and a rebranded World Poker Tour poker room.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Land-based casino with a riverboat design, featuring a large gaming space and a poker room.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: As a major casino in the Cincinnati metropolitan area, it contributes to the local economy and entertainment industry.
world knowledge.Details: Owned by Gaming and Leisure Properties and operated by Penn Entertainment. The casino features nearly 9,000 guest capacity and 4,400 gaming positions.

world knowledge.Name: Ho-Chunk Casino
world knowledge.Address: S3214 Cty Rd BD Baraboo, Wisconsin 53913
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Ho-Chunk Gaming – Wisconsin Dells is a Native American casino and hotel owned by the Ho-Chunk Nation of Wisconsin. It was previously known as the Ho-Chunk Casino Hotel and Convention Center before the name was changed in 2010. In 2016, the facility underwent a multi-million dollar expansion project.

Major_Events.Description: The casino was renamed from Ho-Chunk Casino Hotel and Convention Center to Ho-Chunk Gaming.
The facility broke ground on a multi-million dollar expansion project.
The casino closed for over two months during the COVID-19 pandemic and reopened with safety protocols.
A technical issue forced all Ho-Chunk gaming centers to close for a weekend.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is one of six Ho-Chunk casinos in Wisconsin and is culturally significant as it is owned and operated by the Ho-Chunk Nation, representing Native American gambling enterprises.

Details.Gaming_Options: Over 2,000 slot machines and 48 table games
Details.Operating_Hours: 24 hours Thurs-Mon/Tues-Wed 9am-1am, seven days a week
Facilities: Conference rooms or event venues for rental
RV park with full hookup sites and tent camping

world knowledge.Name: Isle Casino Waterloo
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Isle Casino Hotel Waterloo opened on June 30, 2007, after significant lobbying by the Black Hawk County Gaming Association to bring a casino to this area of the state. Initially operated by Isle of Capri Casinos, it was later acquired by Eldorado Resorts (renamed as Caesars Entertainment) in 2017.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened on June 30, 2007, operated by Isle of Capri Casinos.
Eldorado Resorts (later renamed as Caesars Entertainment) acquired Isle of Capri Casinos, including Isle Waterloo.

world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is significant for its role in local entertainment and tourism, providing gaming and hospitality services in Waterloo, Iowa.
world knowledge.Details: The casino hosts over 1,000 slot machines, 25 table games, and sports betting through a partnership with William Hill. It also features a hotel on-site and 3 restaurants.

world knowledge.Name: Eldorado Resort Casino
world knowledge.Address: 345 North Virginia Street, Reno, Nevada, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Eldorado Resort Casino is a hotel and casino located in Downtown Reno, Nevada. It was announced in July 1972 by a group of six investors, including members of Reno's prominent Carano family. The hotel opened on May 24, 1973, with 278 guest rooms, two restaurants, and a casino with 200 slot machines, 9 table games, and a keno game. Over the years, it underwent multiple expansions and improvements, growing to 814 hotel rooms by 1989 and adding various amenities such as a micro-brewery, a convention center, and a Broadway-style showroom.

Major_Events.Description: The hotel opened with 278 guest rooms, two restaurants, and a casino with 200 slot machines, 9 table games, and a keno game.
Guestrooms were increased to 411, and further expansions in 1985 added 20,000 square feet of gaming area and four new restaurants.

Coinciding with the construction of Silver Legacy Reno, the Eldorado added a crossover to the new downtown property connected by The Brew Brothers micro-brewery. The Spa Tower was created, adding 10 floors of luxury accommodations, a convention center, and a 580-seat Broadway-style showroom.
Eldorado Resorts announced plans to invest more than $50 million in enhancements, including renovation of more than 4,100 guest rooms across the connected properties.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Eldorado Resort Casino features a theme inspired by El Dorado. It includes multiple towers (Spa Tower, Skyline Tower, Sierra & Virginia Towers), a micro-brewery, a convention center, and a Broadway-style showroom. The property is part of a network of connected hotel-casinos in downtown Reno.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Eldorado Resort Casino is a significant landmark in Reno, Nevada, known for its contributions to the local economy and entertainment industry. It anchors a network of connected hotel-casinos and has been a major player in the development of downtown Reno's gaming and hospitality sector.
world knowledge.Details: The casino houses an on-site microbrewery, The Brew Brothers, which also operates as a music venue and night club. The showroom seats 580 and has rotating productions. The property is owned and operated by Caesars Entertainment.

image_name: Main Street Station Hotel and Casino and Brewery

world knowledge.Name: Main Street Station Hotel and Casino and Brewery
world knowledge.Address: 200 North Main Street, Las Vegas, NV
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Main Street Station is a hotel and casino in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada. It originally opened in 1978 as the Holiday International, part of the Holiday Inn franchise. The casino closed in 1980 due to financial problems, and the hotel closed in 1984. It was renovated and reopened as the Park Hotel and Casino in 1987, which operated until 1990. Florida developer Bob Snow purchased the property and reopened it as Main Street Station in 1991, featuring a Victorian theme and various antiques. The property faced financial difficulties and was sold to Boyd Gaming in 1993. After a $45 million renovation, it fully reopened in 1996.

Major_Events.Description: The hotel opened in February 1978 with 416 rooms, and the casino opened on June 30, 1978.
The casino closed in September 1980 after going into bankruptcy.

Major_Events.Event: Reopening as Park Hotel and Casino
Major_Events.Description: The property reopened on September 3, 1987, after renovations by Japanese investor Katsuki Manabe.
Bob Snow renovated the property with a Victorian theme and reopened it on August 30, 1991.
Main Street Station filed for bankruptcy and closed in June 1992.
Boyd Gaming bought the property for $16.5 million.
Main Street Station fully reopened on November 22, 1996, after a $45 million renovation.
The casino closed in March 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic and reopened on September 8, 2021.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Victorian-era theme with various antiques, including stained glass, chandeliers, and railroad cars. The property features a microbrewery and a section of the Berlin Wall in the men's restroom.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Main Street Station is notable for its Victorian theme and extensive collection of antiques, including a piece of the Berlin Wall. It is popular among locals and Hawaiian tourists and is part of the downtown Las Vegas casino scene.
world knowledge.Details: Main Street Station has 406 hotel rooms and a 26,918 sq ft casino. It features the Triple 7 microbrewery, which has won awards for its beers. The property also includes the Garden Court buffet and various antiquities on display, such as railroad cars and a portion of the Berlin Wall.

world knowledge.Name: Bally's Shreveport
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Bally's Shreveport Casino & Hotel opened as Hollywood Casino Shreveport in December 2000 as the fifth riverboat casino in the Shreveport-Bossier City market. It was originally owned by Hollywood Casino Corporation and cost $230 million to construct. Over the years, it underwent ownership changes and rebranding, eventually becoming Bally's Shreveport in 2021.

Major_Events.Description: The casino hotel opened with a 30,000 square foot casino, a 14-floor hotel, and multiple restaurants.
Hollywood Casino Corporation filed for bankruptcy, leading to the sale of the property.
Eldorado Resorts, Inc. (now Caesars Entertainment, Inc.) purchased the casino for $154 million and rebranded it as Eldorado Resort Casino Shreveport.
Twin River Worldwide Holdings (now Bally's Corporation) announced its intention to purchase the property, completing the acquisition for $165 million in December 2020.
The casino resort was renamed to its current name, Bally's Shreveport Casino & Hotel.

Major_Events.Event: Sale to Gaming and Leisure Properties
Major_Events.Description: Bally's sold the land and buildings to Gaming and Leisure Properties for $120 million in a sale-and-leaseback deal.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The hotel features an 18-story tower with 403 rooms. The casino is a riverboat type with over 1,100 slot machines and 50 live-action table games.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Bally's Shreveport is a significant entertainment and gaming destination in the Shreveport-Bossier City area, contributing to the local economy and tourism.
world knowledge.Details: The property is owned by Gaming and Leisure Properties and operated by Bally's Corporation. Previous names include Hollywood Casino Shreveport (2000-2004) and Eldorado Shreveport (2005-2021).

world knowledge.Name: Golden Nugget Atlantic City
world knowledge.Address: 1 Castle Boulevard, Atlantic City, New Jersey
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened in 1985 as Trump's Castle, it was renamed Trump Marina in 1997. Landry's, Inc. purchased the casino from Trump Entertainment Resorts in 2011 and renamed it Golden Nugget Atlantic City. The property has undergone several ownership changes and renovations over the years.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened as Trump's Castle after Hilton Hotels was denied a gambling license and sold the property to Donald Trump.
The property was rebranded as Trump Marina after negotiations to sell a stake to Colony Capital fell through.
Landry's, Inc. acquired the property for $38 million and renamed it Golden Nugget Atlantic City.
Landry's spent $150 million on renovations, adding new restaurants, clubs, and modernizing the resort.
Golden Nugget launched a real-money online casino site, which later became a market leader in New Jersey.
UNITE HERE Local 54 union members went on strike, leading to an agreement for better wages and benefits.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features a 74,252 sq ft casino, 717 guest rooms, multiple restaurants, a theater, a recreation deck with a pool and sports facilities, and a marina. The main reception area is 210 ft long, with amenities centrally located.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Golden Nugget Atlantic City is a significant landmark in Atlantic City's casino and entertainment industry. It has hosted numerous high-profile entertainers and events, contributing to the city's cultural and economic landscape.
world knowledge.Details: The resort includes a 640-slip marina, a sportsbook for betting, and a rooftop transmitter for WWFP 90.5 FM. It has undergone multiple renovations and rebrandings, reflecting its dynamic history in the Atlantic City casino market.

world knowledge.Name: Scarlet Pearl Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally named the Can Can Casino Resort and Spa, the project gained site approval from the Mississippi Gaming Commission in February 2010. Development stalled due to the Great Recession. Revised plans for the casino, renamed the Scarlet Pearl, were approved in December 2013. Groundbreaking occurred in July 2014, and the property opened on December 9, 2015, at a cost of $290 million.

Major_Events.Description: On October 1, 2019, the Scarlet Pearl's sportsbook accepted Jim 'Mattress Mack' McIngvale's $3.5 million wager on the Houston Astros to win the 2019 World Series. In total, McIngvale wagered $6.2 million at the Scarlet Pearl over October 2019, all on the Houston Astros to win the World Series.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort includes a 300-room hotel, 68,000 square feet of gaming space with a high limit area, a 36-hole miniature golf course, a swimming pool, and a fitness center.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Scarlet Pearl Casino Resort is a significant entertainment and gaming destination in Mississippi, contributing to the local economy and tourism industry.
world knowledge.Details: The resort features several dining options including Scarlet's Steak and Seafood, Under the Oak Cafe, Chopstx, Ami Pizza, and Lounge Nocherie. It also includes a buffet and a newly built high limit gaming area opened in late 2020.

world knowledge.Name: Klondike Hotel and Casino
world knowledge.Address: 5191 S Las Vegas Blvd, Paradise, NV, USA
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Klondike Hotel and Casino began as the Tiki/Hawaiian-themed Kona Kai Motel in 1962. It was purchased by Ralph Engelstad in 1969 and later sold to John Woodrum, who renamed it Klondike Inn in 1976. A casino was added in 1982, and the property became popular among locals for its affordable amenities. It closed in 2006 and was demolished in 2008 to make way for a planned resort that was never built. The site is now a Harley-Davidson dealership.

Major_Events.Description: The property originally opened as the Tiki/Hawaiian-themed Kona Kai Motel.
Ralph Engelstad bought the motel using proceeds from the sale of the North Las Vegas Air Terminal.
John Woodrum took over operations and renamed the property Klondike Inn.
The Klondike received a gaming license and became known as Klondike Hotel and Casino.

Major_Events.Event: Sale to Royal Palm Las Vegas
Major_Events.Description: The property was sold for redevelopment, leading to its closure in 2006.
The Klondike was demolished after plans for the Paramount Las Vegas project stalled.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The Klondike initially featured a Tiki/Hawaiian theme before adopting a Western theme. It included a 153-room motel and a 7,700 sq ft casino. The property was modest compared to larger Las Vegas resorts, catering primarily to locals and budget-conscious visitors.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Klondike was a beloved local casino known for its affordable gambling and dining options. It was also notable for its proximity to the Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas sign, which it helped power in the 1970s. The property appeared in films like 'Vegas Vacation' and 'Miss Congeniality 2,' as well as a music video by Avenged Sevenfold.
world knowledge.Details: The Klondike was the southernmost hotel on the Las Vegas Strip until its closure. After demolition, the site remained vacant until a Harley-Davidson dealership opened in 2014. The property's history reflects the evolution of the Las Vegas Strip from small motels to megaresorts.

world knowledge.Name: Royal Nevada
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Royal Nevada was a hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip, opened in 1955. Designed by Paul Revere Williams, it faced financial struggles and multiple closures. It was eventually absorbed into the Stardust resort, serving as convention space until its demolition in 2007.

Major_Events.Description: The Royal Nevada opened on April 19, 1955, as one of four new Las Vegas resorts opening within a six-week period.
Financial difficulties forced the casino to close less than a year after opening.
The hotel reopened under the management of the New Frontier resort, serving as an overflow facility.
The casino closed permanently on January 30, 1958, due to financial and regulatory issues.
The Royal Nevada was repurposed as the Stardust Auditorium, providing convention space and additional rooms for the Stardust resort.
The former Royal Nevada structure was demolished along with the Stardust to make way for the Echelon Place development.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Designed by Paul Revere Williams, the resort featured a large jeweled crown above the entrance made of gold leaf and glass, and another crown on its roadside sign. The building included a $250,000 plumbing system for the Dancing Waters show.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Royal Nevada was part of the mid-20th century expansion of the Las Vegas Strip, reflecting the era's architectural and entertainment trends. Its struggles highlighted the challenges of overbuilding and financial mismanagement in early Las Vegas.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Hotel and casino, later repurposed as convention space.
world knowledge.Details: The Royal Nevada hosted performances such as 'Guys and Dolls' and the 'Dancing Waters' show. It was also involved in legal and financial disputes, including allegations of card cheating and unpaid debts. The resort's iconic crown sign is preserved in the Neon Museum.

world knowledge.Name: Rising Star Sports Ranch
world knowledge.Physical_Area: 30,000 sq ft (2,800 m2) indoor sports facility, 4-acre outdoor area
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened as the Mesquite Star hotel-casino in 1998, it faced financial difficulties and closed in 2000. It was later operated as the Virgin River Convention Center before being purchased by the Lee family in 2013. The property was renovated and reopened as the Rising Star Sports Ranch Resort in 2016, focusing on sports training and competitions.

Major_Events.Description: The Mesquite Star hotel-casino opened on July 1, 1998, featuring a 12,000 sq ft casino, 210 hotel rooms, and three restaurants. It was the fifth hotel-casino in Mesquite.
NevStar Gaming filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in December 1999, leading to the closure of the Mesquite Star in March 2000 due to financial issues and legal disputes.
After extensive renovations, the property reopened as the Rising Star Sports Ranch Resort on October 1, 2016, focusing on sports facilities and non-gaming accommodations.
The 30,000 sq ft indoor sports facility, The Barn, was completed in May 2017, marking the final phase of the Rising Star resort.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features a four-floor hotel with 210 rooms, including adjoined rooms with bunk beds. The Barn is designed to resemble a red barn and includes a wood floor for basketball and other sports, with AstroTurf for other games. The Backyard area includes outdoor courts, a swimming pool, and picnic areas.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Rising Star Sports Ranch Resort is significant for transforming a failed casino into a thriving sports facility, catering to youth and amateur athletes. It has become a hub for sports events and training, contributing to Mesquite's reputation as a sports destination.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Hotel resort and sports training facility
world knowledge.Details: The resort includes advanced features such as room-service robots and RFID wristbands for access and payments. It has hosted numerous sports events and teams from various states. The property was listed for sale in November 2023 and is permanently closed as of January 2025.

world knowledge.Name: Harrah's Reno
world knowledge.Address: 219 North Center Street, Reno, Nevada, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Harrah's Reno was the first property of the Harrah's casino chain, founded by William F. Harrah. It opened as a bingo parlor in 1937 and evolved into a major casino hotel. The property expanded over the decades, acquiring neighboring casinos and adding hotel towers. It played a significant role in Reno's gaming and entertainment industry before closing in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The site is now being redeveloped into a mixed-use project called Reno City Center.

Major_Events.Description: William F. Harrah opened his first bingo parlor, which later evolved into Harrah's Heart Tango.
Noted casino architect Martin Stern Jr. designed and constructed a luxury hotel tower atop the former Grand Hotel.
A new tower was added by Holiday Inn, the then-owners of the property.

Major_Events.Event: Renaming of Headliner Room to Sammy's Showroom
Major_Events.Description: The showroom was renamed in honor of Sammy Davis Jr., who had performed there regularly.
Both Harrah's and the adjacent Hampton Inn were closed temporarily due to water damage.
An outdoor entertainment venue was opened on the site of the former Nevada Club and Harold's Club.
Harrah's Reno closed due to the COVID-19 pandemic and was later sold for redevelopment.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The property featured multiple towers, including a 24-story hotel tower designed by Martin Stern Jr. The casino space expanded over time, incorporating neighboring buildings and connected via airways. The design included gaming floors, showrooms, and dining venues.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Harrah's Reno was a cornerstone of Reno's gaming and entertainment scene, hosting top headliners and serving as the flagship property of the Harrah's chain. It played a key role in the city's tourism and economic development.
world knowledge.Details: Harrah's Reno was known for its showroom, Sammy's Showroom, which hosted numerous famous performers. The property underwent multiple renovations and expansions over the years. It was sold in 2020 and is being redeveloped into Reno City Center, a mixed-use project including apartments and commercial spaces. The redevelopment has faced financial and regulatory challenges, including bankruptcy filings and delays.

world knowledge.Name: Sands Hotel and Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Sands Hotel and Casino was a historic hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, that operated from 1952 to 1996. Designed by architect Wayne McAllister, it was the seventh resort to open on the Strip. It hosted many famous entertainers, most notably the Rat Pack and Jerry Lewis. The hotel was established in 1952 by Mack Kufferman and later acquired by figures such as Howard Hughes and Sheldon Adelson. It was demolished in 1996 to make way for The Venetian.

Major_Events.Event: Opening of Sands Hotel and Casino
Major_Events.Description: The hotel opened on December 15, 1952, with 200 rooms and a casino. It quickly became a popular destination for entertainers and high rollers.
The classic caper film Ocean's 11 was shot at the hotel, featuring the Rat Pack. This event solidified the hotel's iconic status.
Howard Hughes purchased the hotel for $14.6 million and oversaw the construction of a 500-room tower.

Major_Events.Event: Demolition of Sands Hotel and Casino
Major_Events.Description: The hotel was imploded and demolished on November 26, 1996, to make way for The Venetian, a new megaresort.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The original design by Wayne McAllister featured a terracotta red-painted modern hotel with a prominent 56-foot high sign. The hotel included a porte-cochère with sharp-edged pillars, a glass-walled entry bordered by Italian marble, and a casino lit by low-hanging chandeliers. The guest rooms were located in stand-alone, two-story buildings named after famous race tracks. A 500-room circular tower was added in 1967.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Sands Hotel and Casino is culturally significant for its association with the Rat Pack and its role in the entertainment history of Las Vegas. It was a hub for famous performers and celebrities, and its Copa Room hosted some of the greatest names in entertainment. The hotel also played a role in the integration of Las Vegas, allowing black performers like Nat King Cole and Sammy Davis Jr. to stay and perform.
world knowledge.Details: The Sands Hotel and Casino was known for its Copa Room, which hosted legendary performances by entertainers like Frank Sinatra and Dean Martin. The hotel also featured the Silver Queen Lounge, popular with the rock 'n' roll crowd. Notable albums were recorded in the Copa Room, including live performances by the Rat Pack. The hotel was demolished in 1996, and The Venetian now stands in its place.

world knowledge.Name: Harrah's Council Bluffs
world knowledge.Address: 1 Harrah's Boulevard, Council Bluffs, Iowa, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Harrah's Council Bluffs began as Harvey's, opening in 1996 with the Kanesville Queen riverboat, a three-story floating casino. Harrah's acquired Harvey's in 2001. In 2007, Iowa law allowed casino operators to move to onshore operations. In 2013, Harrah's scrapped the riverboat due to high maintenance costs and inconvenience, moving operations to a former convention center.

Major_Events.Description: On October 6, 2017, ownership of the property was transferred to Vici Properties as part of a corporate spin-off, and it was leased back to Caesars Entertainment.

Major_Events.Event: Transition from riverboat to onshore casino
Major_Events.Description: Harrah's scrapped the riverboat due to high maintenance costs and inconvenience, moving operations to a 25,000 square foot facility with room for 600 slot machines.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Pavilion theme with a 251-room hotel, 25,000 sq ft gaming space, and modern amenities.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: One of three major casinos in Council Bluffs, contributing to the local economy and entertainment industry.
world knowledge.Details: Harrah's Council Bluffs features amenities such as 2 restaurants, 2 bars, the Stir Concert Cove for live music, and notable dining options like 360 Steak House and Guy Fieri's. It is owned by Vici Properties and operated by Caesars Entertainment.

world knowledge.Name: Borgata
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa is a hotel, casino, and spa in Atlantic City, New Jersey. It is owned by Vici Properties and operated by MGM Resorts International. The casino hotel features 2,798 rooms and is the largest hotel in New Jersey. Borgata opened in July 2003 and is the top-grossing casino in Atlantic City. Borgata was part of a major project in Atlantic City nicknamed 'The Tunnel Project', started around 1999.

Major_Events.Description: Borgata opened on July 2, 2003, at 11:45 pm, as a joint venture between MGM Mirage and Boyd Gaming.
Borgata underwent a $200 million casino and retail expansion, and the new wing opened in June 2006. As part of the expansion, Borgata installed a poker room, the largest in Atlantic City.
Borgata opened its second hotel, The Water Club.
MGM Mirage announced it would sell its stake in Borgata and stop doing business as a gaming licensee in New Jersey.
The New Jersey Casino Control Commission reversed its earlier decision and allowed MGM back into the state.

Major_Events.Event: MGM purchases Boyd's stake in Borgata
Major_Events.Description: MGM agreed to purchase Boyd's 50 percent stake in the Borgata for $900 million in cash and assumed debt.
Vici Properties acquired MGM Growth, including the Borgata.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The main tower is the third tallest building in Atlantic City and is visible from many miles away due to its facade of reflective gold glass. Designed by BLT Architects, Cope Linder Architects, and SOSH Architects (Interior Design/Renovations).
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Borgata is the top-grossing casino in Atlantic City and has been featured in popular culture works such as the film 'The Bounty Hunter' (2010).
world knowledge.Details: The 161,000-square-foot (15,000 m2) casino floor offers about 4,000 slot machines, 180 table games, and 50 poker tables. Borgata’s poker program features daily tournaments and high-stake tournaments in conjunction with the World Poker Tour. The Borgata also has a sportsbook called the Race & Sports Book that offers sports betting. Borgata has extensive online gambling operations. The Main Tower at Borgata stands 431 ft tall and contains 1,997 guest rooms and suites. MGM Tower is a 38-story, $400 million boutique hotel connected to Borgata. The Borgata Event Center is the main music venue for the resort. The Borgata Festival Park is an outdoor venue used during the summer months. The Borgata Music Box is a versatile venue used for music and comedy acts. Borgata's spa, named Spa Toccare, is a 54,000-square-foot (5,000 m2) spa with a salon, a barbershop, a fitness center, and an indoor pool.

world knowledge.Name: President Casino Broadwater Resort
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Originally opened in 1939 as the Broadwater Beach Hotel, it was a hub for illegal gambling before transitioning into a luxury resort. It became a flagship destination on the Gulf Coast, hosting celebrities, politicians, and business leaders. In 1992, it was rebranded as the President Casino Broadwater Resort after adding a riverboat casino. The property faced financial troubles, closed in 2005, and was destroyed by Hurricane Katrina later that year. Plans for redevelopment, including a music-themed resort, have been proposed but not realized.

Major_Events.Description: Opened as a venue for illegal gambling along the Mississippi Gulf Coast.
Gambling ceased, and the facility was renovated into a high-end resort with a marina, golf courses, and entertainment.
Caused significant damage to the resort, but it was later restored.
Rebranded as President Casino Broadwater Resort with a riverboat casino.
Closed due to financial issues, shortly before Hurricane Katrina destroyed the property.
Destroyed the casino barge and heavily damaged the resort, leading to demolition.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Originally built in Art Deco style, later renovated with modern features including a wide arched canopy. The casino operated on a floating barge.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The resort was a symbol of the Mississippi Gulf Coast's tourism and entertainment industry, hosting notable figures and serving as a regional landmark. Its iconic sign and marina were widely recognized.
world knowledge.Details: The property has remained vacant since Hurricane Katrina. Plans for redevelopment, including a music-themed resort by Universal Music Group, have been announced but not yet realized. The site was once home to a state-of-the-art marina and golf courses, which were destroyed in 2005.

world knowledge.Name: Bally's Chicago
world knowledge.Address: 777 W. Chicago Ave, Chicago, Illinois, U.S.
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Bally's Chicago is a casino and entertainment venue temporarily located in the Medinah Temple Building, with a planned integrated resort to be built on the North Branch of the Chicago River. The project was approved by the Chicago City Council in May 2022, and a State of Illinois gambling license was issued in 2023. The casino's construction began in 2024, with an expected opening in 2026. The idea of a casino in Chicago was a topic in the 2019 mayoral election, and legislation expanding gambling in Illinois was passed in June 2019. The city aimed to generate $200 million in annual tax revenue from the casino to fund police and firefighter pension funds.

Major_Events.Description: Mayor Lori Lightfoot approved Bally's Corporation's bid to construct a casino complex in Chicago.
The State of Illinois issued a gambling license for the casino.
The temporary casino at Medinah Temple opened on September 9, 2023.
Construction of the permanent casino and resort began in 2024.
Bally’s, along with the city of Chicago and state gambling regulators, were sued for discrimination over an IPO exclusively for women and minorities.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: Modernism; designed by Solomon Cordwell Buenz (hotel) and Gensler architects (casino resort facilities).
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino is expected to generate significant tax revenue for the city, funding police and firefighter pension funds. It also represents a major development in Chicago's entertainment and tourism industry.
world knowledge.Details: The first phase of the project includes 2,700 slot machines, 95 table games, a suite-only hotel with 100 suites, and an outdoor music venue. A second phase expansion would add 4,000 gaming seats, a 400-room hotel, a 3,000-seat indoor venue, and a 20,000 sq ft exhibition space. The casino's revenue in its first two years was below expectations, with 2023 bringing 25% and 2024 bringing 47% of expected revenue.

world knowledge.Name: Old Camp Casino
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Old Camp Casino was a tribal casino owned and operated by the Burns Paiute Tribe. The name refers to a tribal settlement on the site in the early 20th century. The tribe faced financial challenges due to the remote location of the reservation.

Major_Events.Description: The casino opened in September 1998 with 75 slot machines, two poker tables, and a deli, employing 53 people.
100 additional slot machines were added, while table games were removed due to unprofitability.
The casino was closed on November 26, 2012, due to structural safety concerns. Plans to demolish and rebuild were announced but not realized by October 2014.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The casino building was purchased from the Lummi Tribe and relocated from northwest Washington to the Burns Paiute reservation.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The casino was significant as a tribal enterprise aimed at generating revenue for the Burns Paiute Tribe, despite its remote location and financial challenges.
world knowledge.Details: The tribe secured a $930,000 loan from Indian Gaming of America and purchased the building for $180,000. The casino initially struggled with financing and management issues.

world knowledge.Name: Hollywood Casino Morgantown
world knowledge.Location: Caernarvon Township, Berks County and Lancaster County, Pennsylvania
world knowledge.Historical_Background: Morgantown was named after Colonel Jacob Morgan, who laid out the town around 1770. His father, Thomas Morgan, had been a native of Wales, a captain in the French and Indian War, and owner of a large tract of land in Caernarvon Township. The town was originally agriculture-based but grew with the arrival of manufacturing companies and infrastructure like the Pennsylvania Turnpike and Interstate 176.

Major_Events.Description: Colonel Jacob Morgan laid out the town.
The Morgantown Expressway was built to interstate highway standards, linking Morgantown to PA 23, Reading, and US 422.
New Morgan was incorporated as a borough, though the actual town has yet to be built.
An 80,000-square-foot casino with 750 slot machines and 30 table games opened.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The town features a mix of historic and modern structures, including the restored stone house built by Jacob Morgan, which is rumored to have housed George Washington.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: Morgantown is notable for its early mention of Groundhog Day in 1840, as recorded in the diary of James L. Morris. It also has historical significance due to its founding by Colonel Jacob Morgan and its growth from an agricultural settlement to a manufacturing hub.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Residential and commercial community with historical and cultural significance.

Details.Climate: Hot-summer humid continental climate (Dfa), hardiness zone 6b
Details.Schools: Conestoga Christian School, High Point Baptist Academy, Twin Valley High School
Details.Notable_Businesses: Timet, Morgan Corp., Stoltzfus Spreaders, Viwinco Windows, McNeilus cement mixers
Details.Recreation: Hollywood Casino Morgantown, Classic Auto Mall
Details.Waterways: Drained by the Conestoga River, which flows into the Susquehanna River

world knowledge.Name: Soaring Eagle Casino & Resort
world knowledge.Address: 6800 Soaring Eagle Blvd, Mount Pleasant, MI 48858-8432
world knowledge.Historical_Background: The Soaring Eagle Casino & Resort is a casino, hotel, and entertainment venue owned and operated by the Saginaw Chippewa Tribal Nation. It opened on April 22, 1998, and has since undergone renovations to expand and modernize its facilities.

Major_Events.Description: A series of renovations were approved by the Saginaw Chippewa Tribal Council in August 2017, including the addition of a sports bar and night club, updates to the Entertainment Hall, enclosing the non-smoking area, redesigning Kid's Quest and Cyber Quest areas, a new high-limit and VIP lounge area, and relocating the poker room.

world knowledge.Architectural_Characteristics: The resort features a modern design with a variety of entertainment and hospitality facilities, including a casino, hotel, restaurants, a pool with underwater sound system, a full-service spa, an arcade, a day care, concert hall, and amphitheater.
world knowledge.Cultural_Significance: The Soaring Eagle Casino & Resort is culturally significant as it is owned and operated by the Saginaw Chippewa Tribal Nation, contributing to the local economy and preserving Native American heritage through its operations and offerings.
world knowledge.Primary_Function: Entertainment and hospitality, including gaming, dining, and lodging.
world knowledge.Details: The casino offers a variety of gaming options, including pit and table games, slot machines, an 18-table poker room, and a separate gaming hall called the Slot Palace.
